These are internal architecture terms. Exact public, wire, storage and Action names remain later.

##### Governed-review publication establishment language

**Publication Establishment**: the semantic postcondition that the exact PublicationSubjectV1 has its one canonical Publication Fact and verifier-complete logical closure established at the transaction snapshot. It does not reveal whether this request created or converged on the Fact and does not promise present closure availability forever.
_Avoid_: created publication, already-existing publication, winning publish.

**Authorized Convergence**: a different-key Action Request that independently satisfies all current authority and branch-independent admission requirements at its own serialization snapshot and reaches the same Publication Establishment postcondition without minting another Fact.
_Avoid_: duplicate replay, borrowed Mandate, free already-published success.

**Branch-neutral Ordinary Result**: the adapter-parity semantic Result for successful first establishment and successful Authorized Convergence, exposing the deterministic non-bearer Fact reference but no create-versus-preexisting discriminator or branch-specific metadata.
_Avoid_: full confidentiality guarantee, audit invisibility, timing noninterference.

**Publication Request Audit Record**: any future generic request-scoped Authorization Receipt, Action Result, idempotency or accounting record. It has zero publication, review, Evidence, quorum or governance weight.
_Avoid_: publication occurrence, review receipt, second Fact.

These are internal architecture terms. Exact frozen record, public and wire names remain later.

##### Governed-review convergence authority language

**Publication Establishment Action**: one successful different-key Authority-owned governed mutation whose internal persistence branch either first establishes or independently converges on the one Publication Fact while preserving one semantic Result.
_Avoid_: create-Fact action, duplicate read, already-published shortcut.

**Establishment Action Floor**: the common request-scoped publication set containing the canonical request commitment, exact selected authority consumption, primary generic Authorization Receipt, Action Result and active-generation idempotency mapping.
_Avoid_: publication occurrence, review audit aggregate, winner record.

**Authorizing Witness Set**: one complete canonical set of live Grant path or quorum contributors plus the exact required Mandates used by the evaluator for one request. Only its applicable bounded uses are consumed; unused alternatives remain untouched.
_Avoid_: all matching Grants, all available Mandates, requester-selected path.

**Semantic Publication Capacity**: the one-Fact cardinality class that only first establishment can use. It is distinct from admission, rate, verifier compute, staging, logical reachability, physical bytes and retention, whose accounting remains later.
_Avoid_: generic budget, object capacity.

These are internal architecture terms. Cc17 freezes witness normalization and anti-steering, 73be freezes the pure RankW comparator, and ef04 freezes the pure allocation-attribution join. Exact semantic-key members, provenance and reissuance rules, requirement taxonomy, Mandate assurance, Consumption Cell origin and partition semantics, manifest carriers, accounting, public and wire names remain later.

##### Authority witness normalization language

**Coverage Map**: the canonical mapping from every exact effective Authority Requirement obligation, quorum slot, independence condition and required Mandate to the complete attenuated proof support that satisfies it.
_Avoid_: matching Grants, permission list, best path.

**Debit Map**: the canonical mapping from each exact bounded Grant-use Consumption Cell and required one-use Mandate to the units one successful Action would consume.
_Avoid_: generic budget, path count, all matching authority.

**Consumption Cell**: one context-local immutable identity for a bounded prospective authority unit whose use is debited at most once by one Action even when it appears through several rendered paths.
_Avoid_: counter row, contributor vote, Receipt.

**Selection Basis**: the protected coherent current-state commitment over the complete effective requirement, Authority and governance heads, live witness universe, request subject, time basis and deterministic bounds from which normalization and later allocation are evaluated.
_Avoid_: cached precheck, caller candidate list, current IDs.

**Support-minimal Witness Candidate**: one complete normalized Authorizing Witness Set with no removable support that can disappear while preserving every exact coverage, assurance and independence obligation.
_Avoid_: cheapest path, shortest path, unique proof.

**Witness Allocation Policy**: the still-candidate current-governance class-provenance and carrier contract that supplies total finite class inputs to the locked RankW comparator without raw IDs, caller preference or a second selector head. Cc17 locks normalization and 73be locks comparison; exact semantic-key vocabulary, attribution provenance and carriers remain later forks.
_Avoid_: tie-break by ID, adapter preference, candidate policy, generic matcher.

These are internal architecture terms. Exact final schema, policy algebra, persistent, public and wire names remain later.

##### Authority witness allocation language

**Allocation Class Order**: the still-unfrozen finite current-governance semantic order from spend-first to protect-longer that a later total attribution protocol supplies to the pure comparator.
_Avoid_: record priority key, numeric weight, latest policy, lexical label order.

**Debit Atom**: one distinct cc17 DebitMap entry representing either one bounded Consumption Cell use or one exact required one-use Mandate consumption for one successful Action.
_Avoid_: path count, contributor count, generic cost.

**Terminal Grant Contributor**: one canonical complete Grant-path leaf after coverage, attenuation, quorum, independence and duplicate-derivation validation; Mandates and composite quorum or requirement nodes are not terminal Grant contributors.

**Worst Terminal Class**: the protect-longer maximum class across every terminal contributor's complete Grant ancestry and later frozen current-requirement role floor.

**Witness Rank W**: the fixed pure rank tuple consisting of debit-atom counts from protect-longer to spend-first followed by the Worst Terminal Class. Exactly one minimum may select; equal ranks are unavailable.
_Avoid_: score, cheapest witness, shortest path, ID tie-break.

These are internal candidate architecture terms. The comparator and pure attribution join are locked; exact Allocation Semantic Key members, provenance-source rules, class labels, manifest carriers, persistent and public schemas remain later.

##### Authority allocation-attribution language

**Allocation Attribution Role**: one of the four closed places where 73be needs a semantic class: Grant Ancestry Support, Consumption Cell Debit, Mandate Debit or Requirement Floor.
_Avoid_: key variant, class tag, record priority.

**Grant Ancestry Support**: the attribution use-site applied to every Grant in one terminal contributor's complete ancestry; the terminal leaf is not the only classified Grant.

**Allocation Semantic Key Universe**: the separately frozen finite core set K of shared record-independent semantic meanings eligible for exact class lookup inside one protocol version.

**Allocation Attribution Provenance Closure**: the separately validated exact subject, attribution role, source facts and joins, derivation protocol, source revisions and derived semantic key used as input to the pure lookup.

**Allocation Attribution Commitment**: the protected binding of context, subject, role, key protocol, manifest and class order, provenance closure, source revisions and resulting class consumed by the Selection Basis.

These are internal candidate architecture labels materializing ef04. Exact key members, provenance-source schema, requirement-role taxonomy, Mandate assurance relevance, cell origin and partition semantics, manifest carriers, public names and persistent schema remain later.

**Consumption Cell Conservation Root**: the internal immutable context-qualified conservation identity behind one bounded prospective Authority-use source; b912 defines only its conditional prospective identity/assertion normal form, while concrete kind eligibility and root establishment remain later.

**Consumption Root Closure**: the finite canonical sorted set of exact already-valid same-context roots carried by one derived authority topology after recursive flattening.

##### Recovery-admission Operation language

- **EstablishRepositoryRecoveryAdmission**: Authority-owned pre-store Ceremony that may establish exactly one inert `RepositoryRecoveryAdmissionRecordV1`.
- **EstablishInstallationRecoveryAdmission**: Installation-owned pre-store Ceremony that may establish exactly one inert `InstallationRecoveryAdmissionRecordV1`.
- **DispatchReservationModeV1**: closed `InitiateNew | RecoverReserved` request meaning on exactly four existing reserve Action leaves. `InitiateNew` creates the original Intent/Attempt reservation; `RecoverReserved` targets the same exact `ReservedUnsealedV1` Attempt under fresh current authority and cannot remint or refresh its bound basis.
- **Ceremony Request Mode**: closed `Initiate | RecoverReserved | ResolveResult | Withdraw` request meaning. `Initiate` creates the exact Ceremony Attempt and possible protected crossing; `RecoverReserved` may continue only the same exact pre-seal DispatchAttempt and only its seal-CAS winner may release once; `ResolveResult` can only close the same exact Attempt from proven immutable carrier truth and remains effect-free; `Withdraw` is a fresh same-spec, no-I/O Control-Head transition from `None/prepared | None/confirmed_not_applied` to terminal `None/cancelled` and creates no new Attempt or Run.
- **RecoverReserved**: typed same-DispatchAttempt continuation, distinct from replay, redispatch, reconciliation and Result lookup. It creates no new Intent, Attempt, Run, key, envelope, fence, effect budget or authority carry.
- **Withdraw**: typed local terminal disposition, distinct from Work/Step cancellation, provider cancellation, recovery, reconciliation and Result lookup. It preserves every prior spend and history, refunds nothing and renders `withdrawn locally; no provider cancellation performed`.
- **Ceremony Attempt**: the sealed `CeremonyAttemptCommitmentV1` plus AttemptId used by a pre-store Ceremony; it is not an `ExecutionAttempt` and owns no Run.
- **EffectIntentOriginatingRequestV1**: closed `Action(ActionRequestRefV1) | Ceremony(CeremonyRequestRefV1)` provenance union. Only the Action branch is admissible to `ReconciliationAttempt`.

##### Public Skill and internal job [dec-canonical-capability-skill-resource-831a]

**Public Skill** means the one discoverable host activation named `maestro`: a concise non-authoritative Integration router.

**Internal job** means one identity-bound, progressively disclosed branch inside that Skill. The closed set is Setup, Research, Design, Review, Execute, Recover and Adapt. An internal job is not a public Skill, lifecycle, authority boundary, Recipe owner or independent activation unit.

**Review** absorbs audit and witness journeys without approval or completion authority. **Execute** replaces the ordinary Work/Step execution journey. **Recover** preserves stale and in-doubt uncertainty and requires the locked fresh-authority paths. **Adapt** exposes only Extension-Law-permitted extension jobs.

Its closed jobs are the seven internal jobs; its status is Selected, Ambiguous or Blocked. It never selects or changes the canonical next action.

**JobGuidanceEnvelopeV1** is the separate Integration view `PacketGuidance(exact AgentPacketV1, exact JobRouteV1) | BootstrapGuidance(exact bootstrap-fact view, exact JobRouteV1)`. The contained Packet remains byte-, schema- and hash-identical. Raw Packet JSON remains available; the MCP Packet envelope never carries this companion.

Selected always contains the already selected job; the job-only plan is the zero-method success case. Every bounded output invalidates both resolution and JobRoute.

**ReviewMethodLoadPlanV1** is one absent-or-present fixed primary plus one unique ordered subset of the exact permitted auxiliary Resources. Auxiliaries execute only inside the primary invocation and produce no independent Review result or publication edge.

**ContextBudgetProfileV1** is the Release- and supported-host-bound evidence profile over UTF-8 bytes and host/tokenizer-observed units for every reachable instruction closure. It admits or refuses a host; it never truncates a closure or creates universal numeric product limits.

##### Review mode and compound intent [dec-canonical-capability-skill-resource-831a, incorporating a405]

**ReviewModeV1** is exactly Inspect, Audit, AdversarialReview, QAReplay or CloseReview. Audit and Adversarial Review are methods, not Recipes; CloseReview is an evidence-oriented witness replacement, never approval or close authority.

**ReviewCompoundIntentV1** is exactly `ReviewRepairRecheck(exact_scope_ref, optional requested_mode)`: an ephemeral Integration request that starts with existing `ReviewReadOnly` or the ordinary ReviewRequired reason and then yields to a fresh Packet after every output. It is not a JobRoute field, Operation, queue, cursor, workflow, Recommendation or Grant.

**ReviewMethodInvocationV1** is `Produced(result) | Refused(refusal) | Failed(failure)`. Produced carries one exact five-mode result with bounded coverage plus complete primary-and-auxiliary plan provenance. Partiality is derived from coverage; auxiliaries have no independent invocation/result; method-wide refusal/failure and process crash do not masquerade as produced results; stale reuse writes nothing.

##### Job-to-Recipe admission and return [dec-canonical-closed-job-recipe-eligibility-073b]

**JobRecipeEligibilityV1** is the exact Capability-owned relation from each of the ten current Recipe Resources to its admitted subset of the seven internal jobs. It is not a Recipe field and cannot affect pre-Packet RecipeApplication.

**SelectedJobRecipeAdmissionV1** is the ephemeral post-Selected-JobRoute check over the exact Packet application, route, Release and relation. Its outcome is `NoRecipe | Admitted(one-or-two exact already-selected Recipe refs) | Refused`; it changes no Packet, Advice, route or fact.

**RecipeReturnOccurrenceV1** is one Orchestration-owned explanation per present application component, bound to exact Frontier, component, evaluation outcome and declared same-Release reason identity. It is not a return job, route reason, Observation, transition or retry signal. Its exact reason members and manifest subsets are closed by the dedicated cdb7 taxonomy Decision below.

**RecipeReturnReasonV1** is the exact 30-member structural trace catalog selected by `dec-exact-recipereturnreasonv1-catalog-and-cdb7`: one unique Recipe-qualified member for each exact Recipe id and `NotApplicable | RestrictiveAdvice | HardStop` outcome. It is an integrity discriminator, not a causal explanation. It never supplies a fact, route, Recommendation, authority or lifecycle meaning.

##### Setup mode and resolver [dec-canonical-setupmodev1-and-mode-driven-b37a; dec-canonical-total-setupmoderesolutionv1-4a8a]

**SetupModeV1** is the exact Orchestration-owned procedure vocabulary `Install | Adopt | Migrate | Update | Repair | Rollback | Uninstall` for the one `setup` Recipe. A mode is guidance, not a command, Plan intent, lifecycle, authority class, persisted state or Recipe identity.

**SetupModeRequestV1** is exactly `Require(SetupModeV1) | AcceptUniqueEligible`. `Require(m)` explicitly accepts only `m`. `AcceptUniqueEligible` explicitly accepts the fact-derived member only when the eligible set is a singleton. Missing input, prose, flag aliases, paths, legacy values and adapter defaults construct neither variant.

**SetupFactViewV1** is one coherent one-locality Integration join over exact Release/resolver identity, one `ActiveStore | PreStore | NoStoreInstallationGenesis` acquisition context, source-owner fact commitments and one already advertised Operation binding. Active Store binds one exact RepositoryDomain or InstallationDomain and its Store/Generation/Epoch/Packet-material fences. Pre-Store binds one inactive destination, candidate seal, protected carrier and expected-old token. No-Store genesis binds only its protected realm and candidate and fabricates no domain, Store Generation or Authority Epoch. Integration transports and validates commitments; it owns none of their target, custody, currentness, migration, effect, snapshot, authority or desired-state meanings.

**SetupModeResolutionV1** is exactly `Selected(mode, validated_operation_binding) | Ambiguous(MultipleEligibleModes) | Blocked(SetupModeBlockedReasonV1)`. The blocked reason set is `UnsupportedSchemaOrCatalog | ContextLegalityMismatch | LocalityMismatch | CrossDomainAggregate | StaleFactView | StaleOrUnadvertisedOperation | RecoveryRequired | EffectInDoubt | ConflictingOwnerFacts | UnsafeOrAmbiguousTarget | GenerationUnresolved | MigrationNotReady | TargetOrCustodyUnavailable | DesiredStateUnresolved | NoEligibleSnapshot | AlreadyCurrent | NoEligibleMode | RequestedModeIneligible | OperationModeMismatch | AuthorityUnavailable | CapabilityUnavailable`. Structural invalidity fails before semantic evaluation. Selected is caller-local, non-bearer, non-authorizing, non-persistent and invalid after any relevant Result, fact/currentness change, reconnect or Release/catalog change.

##### Public MCP discovery Tools [dec-canonical-sealed-in-flight-af45; incorporating ebcd, 31b3, 92f7, 6875 and b46b]

**maestro_packet** is the exact read-only MCP query for one bounded current AgentPacket and typed Packet refusal bound to one authenticated host/repository context.

**maestro_cli_search** is the exact read-only MCP query over the structured CLI Capability Catalog of the running installed binary. It returns typed token templates and schema/effect/authority metadata, never shell fragments, eligibility or permission.

Neither is a governed Operation. `Operation` remains exactly `Action | Ceremony`; Agent execution and result recovery use the shell-visible CLI.

##### Managed target custody [dec-post-main-managed-resource-custody-and-ecaf]

- **MaestroOwnedTarget**: one whole declared Resource target whose integrity-valid installed claim and current Receipt are reachable from the active same-domain Store/head and agree with Resource/Bundle, domain/realm/generation and fresh alias-closed target identity. Content equality is not part of custody; Receipt is non-bearer evidence only.
- **SharedManagedBlock**: one exact unique nonoverlapping well-formed bounded block claimed inside a shared target. Maestro owns only that block; every outside byte remains user-owned.
- **Unmanaged**: unclaimed, foreign, externally managed, ambiguous or unsafe target. Ordinary Distribution never mutates it.
- **Preexisting drift**: observed bytes already bound as the exact preimage of a fresh Plan. It is not currentness, adoption or authority.
- **Post-Plan drift**: any content, metadata, identity, alias, claim, Receipt, domain or authority change after the accepted Plan stamp. It is stale and writes nothing.

##### Resource, Bundle and Release candidates [dec-post-main-resource-bundle-and-recipe-53e9]

- **ResourceDescriptorV1**: candidate immutable semantic source descriptor binding stable key, complete content commitment, Resource kind, one semantic owner, required Bundle kind, provenance/license, compatibility/dependencies, non-executable policy references and one disposition. It never binds its containing Bundle/Release or installed state.
- **BundleManifestV1**: candidate immutable owner of one exact ordered Resource-ID set plus exact same-release backward Bundle dependencies and package closure. Dependency is reference, not nested ownership.
- **EmbeddedReleaseBundleV1**: candidate sole platform-qualified Release-kind root binding binary/compatibility and an exact topologically ordered Bundle set.
- **ExternalPattern**: non-authoritative reference knowledge outside the kernel with exact FirstParty or ThirdParty provenance; “external” does not mean only third-party.
- **Installed state**: domain-local current claim and Receipt, never part of Resource, Bundle or Release source identity.

##### Snapshot and retention language [dec-post-main-two-snapshot-catalog-and-134c]

- **DistributionSnapshotV1**: immutable exact prior state of one stable RepositoryDomain realm or InstallationId, exhaustive only over domain-owned and exactly restorable targets and metadata.
- **Ordinary Rollback Catalog**: same-domain current head with capacity two over eligible distinct prior committed Distribution snapshots; it excludes current state and protected-only objects.
- **Eligible snapshot**: a prior current state promoted only by the same atomic commit that publishes its successor Receipt and claim, or an exact genesis-absence state sealed by the applicable genesis law.
- **Protected retention root**: existing Persistence `RetentionPinV1`/reachability protection for unfinished effects, recovery, legal, export, replay, migration rollback and compatible binary/protocol/resource closures; never ordinary-selectable.
- **Cleanup debt**: a physically retained but catalog-inaccessible object left after a failed fenced sweep; it grants no fallback or rollback authority.
- **Snapshot deficit**: fewer than two eligible prior states during bootstrap, security erasure or authorized deletion; it is visible and never filled by fabrication.

##### Activation-topology language [dec-final-corrected-post-main-0576]

- **UserAgentInstallationClosureV1**: one InstallationId-bound global user-agent Resource/currentness closure for one protected realm.
- **Active Skill materialization**: the sole managed Skill content at ~/.maestro/skills/maestro.
- **Host activation entry**: a receipt-bound alias display locator at ~/.agents/skills/maestro or ~/.claude/skills/maestro resolving to the active materialization; not a duplicate Resource or currentness head.
- **AgentBootstrap Resource**: embedded/bootstrap/MAESTRO.md source materialized as one RepositoryDomain .maestro/MAESTRO.md plus one exact AGENTS managed pointer template.
- **Admitted host**: an explicitly selected supported host/config-root/user whose installed descriptor and live-connection contracts can prove exact Release, catalog, context and reconnect behavior.
- **Project setup closure**: Repository-domain bootstrap, managed pointer and Adapt Resources only; it contains no MCP or global Skill target.

##### Coherent-cutover language [dec-canonical-coherent-installation-cutover-ebba]

- **Declared-root manifest**: the finite platform/host-qualified set of exact display/resolved discovery, config, cache, descriptor, manager, shadow, quarantine and explicit migration roots whose alias closure bounds one cutover claim. It is not a home-filesystem absence oracle.
- **Cutover target closure**: every new destination, authorized legacy source, protected destination, consumer and explicit absence affected inside one exact authority domain.
- **Sealed quarantine**: immutable protected legacy bytes plus recoverable metadata outside every active discovery/autoload/fallback root; non-bearer, non-current and nonselectable.
- **Active-consumer zero**: no live discovery, dispatch, autoload, old-client, old-catalog, alias, source or generated-reference consumer before semantic currentness. It is distinct from later physical-reader zero.
- **Protected sealed reader**: an explicitly typed nonautoloading migration, audit or pre-accept rollback reader permitted during retention; it grants no runtime compatibility or authority.
- **Cutover unavailability window**: the interval after any physical effect may have crossed and before context-correct semantic publication or recovery. Neither old nor new closure is ordinarily ready.
- **MigrationCutoverAssociationV1**: the exact Migration-owned typed join from source inventory, declared target closure, custody/effect/quarantine/consumer commitments and the context-correct c868 Receipt to either one ActiveStore Distribution commit or one sealed PreStore Ceremony Attempt. It is outside c868 and becomes current only through the exact owning-domain current-head join or candidate seal frozen by `dec-canonical-typed-migration-cutover-65b3`.

##### Skill-activation observability language [dec-canonical-typed-non-bearer-c27b]

- **SkillActivationCandidateV1**: one ephemeral noncanonical value produced after one complete Selected route and exact Resource-load finalization. It is eligible input to a later authorized Evidence Action, not an Observation, current-job record, cursor or resume token.
- **SkillActivationSubjectV1**: `[schema_version, activation_acquisition_id, acquisition_context, release_ref, root_skill_resource_ref]`, where acquisition context is exactly `ActiveStore(Repository | Installation)` or `Bootstrap(RepositoryBootstrap | InstallationBootstrap)` with the branch's exact domain/generation or bootstrap commitment.
- **SkillActivationPayloadV1**: one self-contained Selected route commitment, one Selected Capability resolution including job-only, one `BootstrapNoRecipe | PacketAdmission(NoRecipe | Admitted[1..2])` Recipe resolution, one ContextBudgetProfile reference and one exact loaded closure.
- **Loaded activation closure**: exactly one job Resource, zero to four direct method Resources, zero to five TDD child Resources, zero or one Research examples Resource, zero to two Recipe Resources and one digest over the complete same-Release closure. Recipes are outside the 31-member Capability instruction tree.
- **Activation acquisition identity**: a fresh nominal event identity for one pure route/load finalization. It is never a payload hash, Session, authority token, cursor or bearer; reuse with different meaning conflicts.
- **LegacySkillActivationImportV1**: a byte-range-indexed Migration record over one `FORMAT-RUN-EVENT-V1` source record, preserving source hash/path/offset/length/order/framing, raw annotations and one non-promoting disposition.

`ResourceContractSuiteV1`: the literal design-time suite of the 38 Resource, Bundle, Release/census, Distribution installed-state, snapshot, closure and census schemas plus their exact protocol-domain and predecessor commitments. `DistributionRuntimeEdgeContractV1`: the 61-row content-bound table that gives every scoped runtime-reference field one expected object kind, cardinality, exact-same-domain law and strict-backward law. Neither is an active Release, mutable registry, installed-state head, authority source or build approval.

## 4. End-to-end human and Agent journeys

The canonical design-to-build journey is `Intake or Research -> Design Revision -> one open Decision at a time -> Resolution -> Decision Materialization -> candidate Contract Root -> contradiction and edge sweep -> exact Build Handoff -> explicit build approval -> separately authorized Contract publication`. Design prose never becomes runtime authority.

The canonical execution journey is `Packet -> one allowed Operation -> current authorization -> commit or fenced external attempt -> Observation -> Evidence/Assessment -> Gate derivation -> fresh Packet`. Projection alone recommends the next action. Recipes may help sequence allowed Operations but cannot create actions, readiness, authority or lifecycle transitions.

The canonical recovery journey is `detect stale, conflict, crash or possible boundary crossing -> preserve durable Intent and occurrence evidence -> return stale/conflict/in_doubt/recovery_required -> obtain a fresh Packet and, where required, fresh authorization -> reconcile or restore exact same-domain state`. Blind retry and rollback fiction are forbidden.

The canonical local-withdrawal journey is `fresh Packet -> exact Withdraw Action or Ceremony -> revalidate sole current Head, Home, no-live-Attempt state, prepared-or-confirmed-not-applied classification, fresh ordinary/Bootstrap-G0/CMA basis and exact capacity -> one expected-old same-carrier Head CAS -> committed local-withdrawal Result -> fresh Projection`. It performs no provider I/O, creates no Attempt, Run, Observation or provider key, refunds nothing and makes no provider-cancellation claim. If any competing writer, crossing possibility or stale fact exists, withdrawal refuses and the ordinary recovery/reconciliation journey applies.

The canonical activation-observability journey is `fresh Packet or exact Setup bootstrap facts -> Selected JobRoute -> exact Capability and Recipe resolution -> exact same-Release load -> ephemeral candidate -> discard route -> fresh Packet advertising PublishObservation -> direct authorized Action submission -> immutable SkillActivation Observation or typed refusal -> discard candidate -> fresh Projection`. Publication is optional. A pre-Store Setup candidate may remain only inside the same root-Skill invocation until a causally matching Store and same-Release fresh Packet exist; crash, handoff or drift drops it. No second JobRoute is derived for publication, so telemetry cannot recursively activate Execute.

The canonical Setup journey first observes and splits the request into exact domains. It preserves one Setup Recipe with the exact seven-mode procedure vocabulary `Install | Adopt | Migrate | Update | Repair | Rollback | Uninstall`; only the shared total resolver may render a mode. The caller explicitly supplies `Require(mode)` or `AcceptUniqueEligible`; omission and legacy/default inference fail. The resolver forms one coherent same-locality fact view, derives eligibility without using the Operation, applies the request, then validates the already advertised Operation without replacing it. Contradictory owner facts block; a coherent multiple-choice view is ambiguous under `AcceptUniqueEligible`; Adopt never substitutes for Migrate. Pre-Store bootstrap loads no Recipe. When the repository bootstrap materially depends on the target global Release/CLI/catalog, the InstallationDomain Operation commits first, hosts reconnect and reobserve, and only then may a fresh RepositoryDomain Operation update `.maestro/MAESTRO.md`, the root `AGENTS.md` managed pointer and Adapt Resources. Partial success remains two honest Results; no cross-domain compensation is invented. A stale pre-crossing Plan writes nothing; a partial or possibly crossed effect blocks every ordinary Setup mode and routes through Recover.

Representative proof journeys include tiny one-Step Work, parallel Work, P0 containment then durable remediation, foundation-first recommendation without DAG mutation, failed and successful explicit absorption, self-authorizing-policy rejection, unresolved materialization, Step-amendment races, stale Packet replay, concurrent writes, Inbox proposal versus dependency, external `in_doubt` reconciliation, Memory conflict, user-file-safe update, byte-total migration and rollback-of-rollback.

### Supporting detail and retained evidence

The following material is retained from the prior canonical design. It is supporting detail under the synthesis above, not a competing definition; effective supersession and the authority order in Section 1 control.

#### Human and agent journeys

##### Complete human and agent journeys

1. **Human orientation:** `status -> next -> inspect`; every blocker, need, authority boundary and stop reason remains visible and bounded.
2. **Agent action:** Packet get -> optional typed inspect/search -> prepare one advertised request -> submit -> typed Result -> fresh Packet.
3. **Tiny Work:** one authorized creation atomically publishes a Work and visible Step; execution, Evidence, Gate and completion remain separate explicit actions.
4. **Parallel Work:** Packet advertises one complete immutable wave; an external conductor submits members independently; partial completion and stale members are ordinary and reprojected.
5. **Planning:** confirmed P0 harm yields containment first; absent active harm, foundation-first may rank before remediation without DAG mutation; fairness/hysteresis prevents starvation and thrash.
6. **Design:** Intake/Research -> Design revisions -> separate Decisions -> materialization -> candidate Contract Root -> contradiction/edge sweep -> exact approval -> authorized publication; prose never executes.
7. **Absorption:** failed coverage leaves both Works unchanged; complete atom dispositions permit one atomic successor amendment plus predecessor supersession; unresolved effects remain independently owned.
8. **Execution race:** amendment versus completion serializes on exact roots; stale Lease/term/submission yields `stale` with no authority consumption; non-Step attempts never inherit Lease rights.
9. **External effect:** durable Intent/reservation -> one fenced dispatch -> Observation/classification; possible crossing yields `in_doubt`; only fresh exact-attempt reconciliation may refine it.
10. **Human governance:** protected presentation -> attributable response -> separately evaluated one-use Mandate -> fresh transition recheck; candidate policy never authorizes itself.
11. **Search and Memory:** search returns typed stale-aware refs; change requires a separately advertised Action. Conflicting Memory remains advisory and cannot override current Contract.
12. **Installation:** dry-run Plan -> custody/alias/authority review -> backup/staging -> fenced filesystem/manager effects -> verification -> commit or recovery; user-owned uncertainty blocks.
13. **No active Store:** capability and exact external ceremony only; no fake empty Packet, runtime Action fallback, imported authority or latest-generation choice.
14. **Migration:** frozen v1 -> byte-total inventory/map/quarantine -> verified inactive Repository/Installation Stores -> protected cutovers -> validation/accept or exact rollback boundary.
15. **Recovery:** last-trusted closure plus fresh external admission -> terminal old disposition and fresh lineage -> verified inactive generation -> one protected activation attempt -> confirm, reconcile Unknown, or require new identity; never fail back.

Every journey has an inspect/stop path. No dead end silently retries, widens authority, mutates through a read, or requires an adapter-private escape hatch.

##### Recovery-admission journey refinement

With no active Store, capability exposes the exact branch admission Ceremony. The conductor submits `Initiate`; a conclusive carrier occurrence returns the inert admission record, while possible crossing returns `in_doubt`. Pure result lookup either returns the immutable result or a typed same-spec `ResolveResult` route. A fresh branch-authorized `ResolveResult` may close only the exact existing Attempt without a Run or redispatch. Only after confirmed admission may the separate recovery-execution Ceremony build or activate the verified generation.

##### Governed-review provider journey refinement

A pure inspection opens no response path. A consequential journey binds the current package/material/options and provider contract, classifies presentation, reserves any effect before I/O, publishes the verified presentation Observation, then independently classifies and acquires an explicit response and publishes its joined Observation. Only a later fresh-authorized Authority Action may evaluate that response. Any ambiguous crossing stays `in_doubt`; silence creates no response and no behavior.

##### Distribution acquisition journey refinement

After a pure Plan identifies one exact artifact and domain, an authorized client classifies the provider procedure. A proven-effect-free fetch creates no Intent or Run; an effecting fetch reserves its Intent/fence before I/O and reports any possible crossing as `in_doubt`. A determinate authenticated result becomes `RemoteReadback` and only then may Distribution stage the candidate. Local apply begins later under separate authority and recovery semantics.

##### Capability-probe journey refinement

A human or agent may read Capability or Maturity without causing I/O. If fresh provider Evidence is needed, Projection advertises a separate authorized probe Action. The provider procedure is classified before I/O; effecting work reserves its Intent first; a determinate result is published under the exact Observation kind; ambiguity remains `in_doubt`; and the client requests a fresh pure view. No read silently probes, retries or continues work.

##### CMA Observation-publication journey refinement

After an authorized maintenance acquisition, Projection may expose one compatible publication action. The client submits the exact purpose, kind, source route and slot. Publication rechecks current CMA state, atomically stores one Observation and spends one slot, then returns the immutable local Result. A second kind from the same attempt is a separate Action and slot; mismatch, stale state or ambiguity writes nothing.

##### Basis-qualified Action journey refinement

A human or agent reads one Projection and sees one exact Action or separate Ceremony. Ordinary work supplies ordinary authority; Bootstrap interaction leaves use their leaf-local G0 contract; CMA leaves use the current branch, purpose-specific origin, exact slot and executor assertion. The handler never falls back. Effecting work reserves before I/O, ambiguity remains `in_doubt`, publication is separately authorized, and the next Projection is freshly derived.

##### Installed TUI journey [dec-canonical-hermetic-tui-release-bundle-4803]

A human or agent inspects capability, launches the admitted offline TUI from the current Release Closure, receives the same Packet and next Operation as other adapters, submits that exact Operation and reads the canonical Result. Any bundle or compatibility fault returns an exact capability/recovery path and never falls back to developer files.

##### One-Skill journeys [831a incorporated by 7138]

A new user invokes `maestro`, issues the explicit `BootstrapNoRecipeV1` read and reaches Setup only when its exact `BootstrapRouteFactViewV1` supports that route; Store absence alone is insufficient. An agent with current Work discovers the exact selection context when necessary, submits one `ProjectV1` read and reaches Execute only from the returned canonical Projection Packet before submitting one exact Operation. A reviewer reaches Review and may publish Evidence/Assessment inputs but cannot approve or complete. A stale or in-doubt packet routes to Recover, which preserves uncertainty and never blind-retries. Extension work routes to Adapt and remains inside the Extension Law. Research may lead to Design, but neither answer nor prose changes runtime authority. Close/release witness work is a Review journey, not a separate public Skill or grant. Activation loads only the root; JobRoute loads one job and zero methods; the shared Capability resolver then either keeps job-only guidance or loads the single typed method closure permitted for that bounded invocation.

##### Fresh Packet and JobRoute journey [7138 incorporating 5d72]

A client that lacks current Recipe/profile identities obtains one complete `SelectionContextV1`, copies one exact option into `RecipeSelectionRequestV1`, and submits `ProjectV1`. Projection revalidates the identities, constructs one Frontier and returns one exact Packet with its required Recipe binding. The client then asks the shared Release-bound resolver for JobRoute, renders `Next action`, `Agent guidance` and the closed route reason separately, and loads only the selected job. Recovery facts override an explicit Research/Review request. An admitted read-only request may change guidance but leaves Packet hash, Recommendation and Frontier unchanged. If a governed method is needed, the shared Capability resolver validates an exact typed need and loads only its unique dependency closure; JobRoute itself never carries method or Recipe selection. After any Result, bounded read or method output, mutation or expiry, the client discards the discovery context, Packet and route and starts from fresh reads. Ambiguous or Blocked loads no mutation-capable branch.

##### Review, repair and recheck journey [dec-canonical-capability-skill-resource-831a, incorporating a405]

An Agent asks for `ReviewRepairRecheck` against an exact scope. A fresh Packet routes Review through the existing intent/reason, then Capability selects one mode and one exact primary-plus-auxiliary plan. Inspect loads none; Audit may add a typed subset of ArchitectureReview, GenerateAndFilter and Verification; CloseReview may add Verification; AdversarialReview and QAReplay admit no auxiliary. The one primary invocation returns one ephemeral coverage-bound result whose header binds the full plan. A later fresh Packet may advertise `PublishObservation`; only that authorized Action publishes `ReviewFinding` or a source-qualified QA Observation. Another fresh Packet may advertise a repair or route any other lawful job/refusal. Recheck repeats from fresh state. A required independent CloseReview derives separation from Principal, Session and model/tool provenance. Crash before publication leaves zero canonical Evidence, and stale pre-repair material cannot publish after the root changes.

##### TDD and Research-disclosure journey [dec-canonical-capability-skill-resource-831a]

After Execute is selected, an exact behavior-changing Step may request TDD. TDD begins with no child and may load only the typed subset required by the current RED/GREEN question; Mocking requires an external boundary and Refactoring requires current GREEN proof. Review never invokes TDD. After Research is selected, examples remain unloaded unless one typed example need requests the exact Research examples Resource; all other jobs refuse that edge. Every supported host proves the resulting closure against its current `ContextBudgetProfileV1` or refuses without truncation.

##### Job and Recipe loading journey [073b incorporated by 7138]

Projection first seals the exact RecipeApplication and Packet. JobRoute then selects one job without loading Recipes. Capability checks the selected job against the already selected primary/continuation components. A matching pair loads only those exact Resources; a non-edge, stale or mixed Release refuses the whole load and never changes the Packet or route. Recipe completion or hard-stop explanation is rendered as Recipe-scoped trace. Only later canonical facts and a fresh Packet may select another job.

##### MCP and shell journeys [dec-canonical-sealed-in-flight-af45; incorporating ebcd, 31b3, 92f7, 6875 and b46b]

With MCP and shell, an Agent reads `maestro_packet`, optionally queries `maestro_cli_search`, then invokes the exact Installation-bound CLI argv and reprojects. With shell only, the Skill/bootstrap uses CLI Packet/capability discovery. With MCP only, reads work but mutation reports not-ready. A stale process, changed PATH, wrong repository root, mixed Release or old descriptor cache refuses before mutation. Human TUI operation remains lawful without an MCP mutation path.

##### Managed-resource drift journey [dec-post-main-managed-resource-custody-and-ecaf]

Setup or Recover inspects a drifted target. If current claim, Receipt, declared Resource and alias-closed identity qualify it as `MaestroOwnedTarget`, Projection reports not-current and offers the exact domain-local planning path. The human or Agent sees the preimage, diff, authority and recovery source; explicit phased execution compare-and-captures before replacement. A concurrent edit returns stale. A shared target changes one exact block only. Missing proof, foreign ownership, ambiguous markers or unsafe aliases stops with no write and no force recommendation.

##### Resource discovery and installation journey [dec-post-main-resource-bundle-and-recipe-53e9]

A human or Agent inspects one exact Release, sees required and optional Bundles plus compatibility/provenance/license, and selects a domain-local desired state. Setup can install the one Skill and required adapters while leaving the third-party brand pack default-off; Design may later select one exact pattern without loading the pack as authority. Capability follows an exact Orchestration Recipe reference. Any missing license, dependency, target collision, mixed Release or unknown Resource refuses before mutation.

##### Snapshot and rollback journeys [dec-post-main-two-snapshot-catalog-and-134c]

A human or Agent inspects one domain-scoped rollback Projection that shows current state, zero to two eligible prior states, compatibility, deficits, protected recovery status and exact refusal reasons. Selecting rollback creates a fresh authorized same-domain Operation; the client never supplies an old Receipt as authority. For current S3 and catalog [S2,S1], rollback to S2 commits current S2 and [S3,S1]; rollback to S3 commits current S3 and [S2,S1]. If activation is in doubt, a hold exists, the manager cannot restore exactly, security erasure invalidated bytes or another domain is required, Projection recommends the exact recovery/inspect/other-domain path and never guesses or retries.

##### Setup and activation journeys [dec-final-corrected-post-main-0576]

First setup begins from the running CLI capability plus `no_store` `InstallationContextGenesis` path, not the absent Skill or MCP. Recovery admission remains a separate `pre_store` path. For complete setup, the Agent performs one advertised global/manager action, receives its Result, reobserves, then performs a separately advertised repository action. A repository-only request may use the exact compatible shell fallback when its host profile allows it; otherwise it returns the explicit global prerequisite. Missing optional hosts are visible but not fabricated. Partial global effects enter Recover; global success plus project failure remains two truthful Results. Rollback and uninstall select only their own domain state.

##### Coherent Installation cutover journey [dec-canonical-coherent-installation-cutover-ebba]

The operator first fences every old writer and proves the finite declared-root closure. Migration inventories and classifies every source/installed artifact, seals the coherent v1 preimage as protected-only material, then stages the compatible vNext Release. Distribution visibly plans each exact target: qualifying claimed drift may be replaced, an explicit custody transition may admit unclaimed user-controlled material, and a truly Unmanaged collision stops the journey untouched. New Skill/MCP/host targets are materialized and authorized legacy names leave discovery through separately classified effects. During that window the Agent sees Recover, never a usable mixed installation. After full reobservation and active-consumer refusal, active-store uses one final Store commit or pre-store `InstallationV1Cutover` publishes its complete inactive Store through the protected expected-old carrier. Old host connections remain unavailable until reconnect; a later Repository bootstrap is a fresh separate journey.

##### Setup-mode resolution journey [dec-canonical-total-setupmoderesolutionv1-4a8a]

In active Store, the caller obtains one current Packet/material basis, forms one domain-local fact view and explicitly submits `Require(mode)` or `AcceptUniqueEligible`. The shared resolver derives eligibility from owner facts before checking the Operation. Six ordinary modes validate only the matching Distribution Plan intent; Adopt validates only `AdoptManagedRegion` or `TransferWholeFileCustody`. In no Store, only `InstallationContextGenesis` may validate fact-eligible Install, Adopt or Migrate as a bootstrap prerequisite; its Result discards the view. In pre-Store, only `RepositoryV1Cutover` or `InstallationV1Cutover` validates Migrate; every recovery, activation, binary-slot, writer-cohort or recovery-admission Ceremony belongs Recover and validates no Setup mode. A coherent multi-mode choice is visible, contradictory facts block, and any partial or possible crossing routes Recover. Every next step begins from fresh state.

## 5. Context and one-owner architecture map

Every concept has one semantic owner. Work owns Work identity/lifecycle/completion, Work Submission and the closed `SupersededBy | Corrects | Continues | References` lineage or informational relation records. Contract owns immutable normative components, revisions, candidate roots, Generations, complete Step-graph definitions and dependency edges, and normative Work Requirements. Step owns stable Step identity and revisions, generation-scoped Binding lifecycle/current applicability, Step Submission and satisfaction. Design owns Design Revisions and synthesis. Decision owns questions, options, Resolutions and rejected alternatives. Execution owns Leases and fencing, the closed ExecutionAttempt variants, Runs, Effect Intents, dispatch/occurrence/reconciliation records, the sole Control Head and local-withdrawal transition, retry, repair and takeover; it supplies atomic Submission preconditions but owns no Submission. Evidence owns Observations, Claims, canonical `AssessmentV1` Gate Assessments, provenance and Evidence applicability/invalidation. Planning separately owns `SchedulingAssessmentV1`; Memory separately owns `AdmissionAssessmentV1`. Every Work- or Step-owned Submission stores one `SubmissionClaimSetV1` digest for a finite non-empty canonical Claim set; every Evidence-owned Claim binds exactly one Submission without transferring ownership. Late contradictory provider Evidence may integrity-block later use but cannot write the Control Head or rewrite `cancelled`. Gate/Policy owns definitions, snapshots, evaluator contracts and derived satisfaction. Authority owns Trust, Principals, Sessions, Grants, Mandates, Delegations, Revocations, Authorization Receipts, recovery authority and the three disjoint ordinary/Bootstrap-G0/CMA withdrawal bases plus their exact capacity laws. Execution may record a recovery Attempt but never absorbs Authority-, Installation- or Distribution-owned recovery semantics. At the Action plane, Work owns seven leaves, Step owns four including `SubmitStep`, and Execution owns sixteen; fixed atomic participation never transfers any record owner or primary Action owner.

Coordination owns Thread Descriptors, Coordination Addresses, immutable Messages, per-Principal Message Acknowledgements, advisory Focus/Scope Declarations, Conflict assertion/resolution Messages and the exact DeliverySubject inputs consumed by delivery origination. Execution owns remote-delivery Effect Intents, dispatch, occurrence classification, reconciliation and withdrawal mutation. Orchestration owns Loop grammar, Recipes, `SetupModeV1`, its fact-to-eligible-mode relation and bounded sequencing guidance. Integration derives and renders Setup guidance and local-withdrawal Result wording only through locked non-authoritative resolvers; it owns transport and presentation but no source fact, Head, basis, mode meaning, eligible-mode ranking, Operation choice or target truth. Planning owns advisory proposals and Scheduling Assessments. Projection owns status, blockers, readiness, next action, stop/inspect paths and the pure Presence and Inbox views; it stores no Presence or Inbox head. Persistence owns Store transactions, immutable history, reachability, exports and recovery boundaries. Search owns disposable indexes. Memory owns governed advisory learning. Intake owns normalization of supplied intent; Research owns sourced inquiry. Integration owns CLI/JSON/MCP/TUI/hook/shell/connector adaptation. Distribution owns Resource acquisition and same-domain mutation protocol. Installation owns protected User-Agent InstallationDomain identity, realm discovery and publication topology. RepositoryDomain owns one exact checkout/worktree Store and project materialization.

No context borrows another owner by storing a reference. Inbox creates no dependency, Memory no policy, Search no authority, Recipe no lifecycle, adapter no semantics, Receipt no custody by itself, Step provenance no dispatch authority and migration labels no live identity.

### Supporting detail and retained evidence

The following material is retained from the prior canonical design. It is supporting detail under the synthesis above, not a competing definition; effective supersession and the authority order in Section 1 control.

#### Relationships

- A draft **Work** has zero or more **Steps**; an executable Work has at least one. Cardinality and containment are not semantic ownership transfer.
- A **Step** belongs to exactly one **Work**, has no children, and is never reparented.
- If an outcome can be accepted, cancelled, owned, or delivered independently, it is a separate **Work** connected by a typed Work relation, not a large Step.
- A satisfied **Step** contributes claims and Evidence references; only the owning **Work** completion authority can accept the outcome.
- **Decision**, **Evidence**, **Run**, **Authorization Receipt**, **Recipe**, and **Projection** support Work and Step but are not additional work identities.
- **Recipe** applies orchestration policy to Work and Step and consumes the canonical Projection; it does not own a competing lifecycle.
- One **SetupModeResolutionV1** consumes exactly one coherent locality fact view, one explicit typed request and one context-correct already advertised Operation binding. Fact eligibility precedes request application; Operation compatibility validates only the selected candidate. The resolution never authorizes, persists or selects a different Operation.
- The one **Setup Recipe** has exactly seven procedure modes. A mode may organize restrictive guidance but never changes the already selected RecipeApplication, selects an Operation, supplies authority or becomes persisted current state. `Adopt` coordinates an explicit custody transition; `Migrate` owns no migration semantics and only constrains the Migration-owned journey.
- A **Work Lifecycle** transition consumes one coherent snapshot of Work, contract, relevant Step revisions, Gate definitions and assessments, Evidence freshness, and authority; stale or missing material inputs reject without mutation.
- A Policy Profile may require additional **Gates** but cannot create or reinterpret Work or Step states or transitions.
- Every adapter consumes the same canonical transition contract and **Projection**; no adapter or generic store verb mutates lifecycle directly.
- A **Recipe** emits only restrictive, non-authoritative Advice over Action Specs already advertised by Projection. It creates no standalone Receipt; an accepted application may add immutable non-bearer Orchestration Attribution to the resulting Action Request and Action Result, and never satisfies a Gate or writes lifecycle state.
- One Work contract generation references zero or more exact **Policy Profiles** and owns exactly one canonical **Gate Snapshot**.
- A **Policy Profile** expands into Gates during authorized contract authoring and is not consulted by transition or Projection runtime.
- A **Gate Snapshot** binds every Gate to its definition, evaluator contract, parameters, and profile provenance; its content hash participates in transition and evaluation freshness.
- Profile composition is additive, commutative, and idempotent; collisions, contradictions, cycles, removals, or weakening attempts fail closed.
- An authorized profile change creates a new Work contract generation and Gate Snapshot; it never mutates existing Work history.
- Every Work and Step has exactly one Lifecycle State and one append-only transition history; only the canonical application transition contract changes either.
- Every `retain_exact` new Step Binding has exactly one `RetainExactInitializationV1`. It is `OpenFreshV1` unless an old satisfied binding and exactly one valid satisfaction-equivalence receipt authorize atomic `SatisfiedByCarryV1`; other old states and carry classes never set lifecycle.
- A Runnable Condition never grants execution. Lease acquisition re-evaluates the same coherent inputs and mints the highest fence for one exact Step revision.
- At most one Lease fence is live for a Step revision. Expiry changes Conditions only; an expired or older fence cannot renew, submit, satisfy, or commit Maestro state.
- A submitted Step owns one current immutable Step Submission that binds a finite non-empty canonical set of Evidence-owned Claims through `SubmissionClaimSetV1`. Rejection or explicit recovery records the prior result before returning the Step to open for a new attempt.
- A cancelled Step has no replacement. A superseded Step names one distinct existing acyclic successor. Neither satisfies dependencies, and dependency edges are never silently rebound.
- Completed Work and satisfied Step remain historical truth when corrected. A new identity and immutable typed relation carry the correction, continuation, or replacement.
- Retention records may relocate or hide terminal Work from default views, but stable identity, lifecycle, history, and relations remain addressable.

- A Work or Step **Submission** binds one finite non-empty canonical set of Evidence-owned **Claims** through `SubmissionClaimSetV1`; each Claim binds exactly one Submission without transferring ownership. The set orders `(normalized_proposition_hash, claim_id, claim_record_hash)` canonically, rejects duplicates and commits one domain-separated digest.
- A Step Claim references one or more direct **Observations**. A Work Claim may also reference exact current Step Submissions.
- One **Observation** may support zero or more Claims and zero or more Assessments. Reuse creates a new Gate-scoped Assessment; a prior pass is never reused.
- One **Assessment** evaluates exactly one Gate node in one Gate Snapshot for one Work generation and optional Step revision.
- An empirical leaf Assessment consumes Observations; an authority leaf consumes Authorization Receipts; a composite Assessment consumes child Assessments through the pinned acyclic Gate graph.
- **Run** owns execution and only acquisition procedures intentionally represented as Runs under the closed `ExecutionAttempt` union, and may emit many Observations. Proven-effect-free transport creates no Run; Authority owns acquisition semantics and complete reduction, while Execution owns any effecting DispatchAttempt or ReconciliationAttempt. Observation never owns or launches Run.
- **Gate** owns definitions, composition, and evaluator contracts; Evidence records their inputs and outputs but never selects policy.
- **Authorization Receipt** is distinct from empirical Evidence. A Gate may assess it by typed reference, but approval, waiver, completion, delivery, and release authority never become Observations.
- **Projection** derives current Gate status from applicable Assessments and exact freshness inputs. Evidence append never writes lifecycle state.
- Many Observations may reference one deduplicated Evidence Payload, while each Observation retains distinct producer, subject, procedure, environment, and time provenance.
- Correction appends linked records. Contract amendment, evidence invalidation, payload tombstone, or Security Erasure Receipt never rewrites historical Observation or Assessment metadata.

- One **Projection** may render one **Agent Packet** for an exact snapshot and view; a Packet advertises zero or more Action Specs and at most one recommendation, which may be one action or one complete parallel wave.
- One **Action Request** instantiates exactly one frozen Action Spec and binds the Packet or exact ceremony reference, expected Store Generation, Authority Epoch, Work generation and material revisions, typed inputs, leaf-specific non-bearer prerequisite Receipt references, idempotency key, and exactly one statically selected ordinary, pre-store, or CMA basis. Ordinary requests bind verified Principal/current Session plus live Grant paths and required Mandates; pre-store requests bind their closed ceremony; CMA requests bind their exact non-Session branch, slot, fresh executor assertion and applicability. No evaluator ranks, combines or falls back among them.
- The canonical action handler rereads current records before mutation; an Agent Packet or Action Spec never bypasses current lifecycle, Gate, Lease, fence, authority, time, or side-effect checks.
- Every **Action Result** corresponds to one Action Request. Reuse of the same idempotency key returns the original semantic result; a differently keyed stale request rejects without mutation.
- CLI, JSON, TUI, hooks, shell and the one Skill are renderers or clients of Packet/Operation/Result. MCP packet-read exposes exactly the three 7138 read modes and six envelope outcomes; the second MCP Tool exposes structured capability discovery. All bind the same internal ActionRequest/CeremonyRequest and Result semantics and never define adapter-private lifecycle or routing.
- A **Recipe** consumes the exact Projection Frontier and sealed Recipe Application before Packet construction and emits only restrictive Advice. Projection alone produces the Packet and Recommendation; the Skill or external client then consumes that Packet and invokes governed CLI Operations. A Recipe cannot mint actions, authority, workers, retries, lifecycle transitions, or run-until-done behavior.
- A parallel wave contains independent Action Specs, but every member is explicitly selected, submitted, rechecked, committed, and receipted on its own.
- Agent Packet, Action Spec, Action Request, and Action Result are not Evidence. Action Result may reference Runs, Observations, Assessments, Authorization Receipts, or transition receipts created by the action.
- Bounded auto-safe continuation is a client-side repetition of newly advertised actions marked auto-safe under pinned Recipe and operating limits; it is never a daemon, queue, scheduler, or hidden executor.

- One repository identity has exactly one active **Store Generation**; older, staged, damaged, backup, export, and migration generations are never runtime candidates.
- The **Canonical Store** uses SQLite as the sole mutable publication authority for metadata and Store Object reachability; the object area contributes immutable bytes but owns no lifecycle, head, index, or precedence rule.
- One **Store Object** may be referenced by many immutable manifests, but a digest match never merges Observation provenance or other typed record identity.
- Every successful **Action Request** publishes its state heads, immutable history, receipts, Action Result, and idempotency record in one short metadata transaction or exposes none of them.
- An **Agent Packet** derives from one coherent Canonical Store read snapshot and cannot combine records from different Store Generations or transaction visibility points.
- Payload-producing actions durably write and verify Store Objects before the metadata transaction references them; unreachable objects are not canonical records and may be collected under audited retention.
- A **Sealed Export** belongs to exactly one Store Generation and closes over its canonical records, reachable objects or tombstones, schemas, checksums, and root manifest.
- A Sealed Export, recovery snapshot, cache, index, Workbench, or Staging Input has no runtime resolution precedence and cannot mutate the Canonical Store directly.
- A **Staging Input** becomes canonical only through typed validation, scoped authority, expected-generation checks, and one Action Request.
- Repository-owned Harness, Policy Profile, Recipe, and evaluator sources remain ordinary authoring files; accepted Work references immutable snapshots and hashes published in the Canonical Store.
- **Semantic Reconciliation** compares explicit base and target generations and appends validated records or conflicts; it never byte-merges databases or silently chooses one side.
- Restore, schema change, migration, or corruption recovery builds and verifies a sibling Store Generation before atomic activation; it never repairs the active authority in place or adds a fallback reader.
- Adapters and domain callers use one storage facade and never issue direct SQL, inspect SQLite journal files, or introduce another repository implementation.
- Generated caches and indexes are disposable; deleting them cannot delete canonical history, alter Store Object reachability, or change a Projection.

- A draft **Work** has one CAS-protected candidate head referencing exactly one current Contract Revision and zero executable Contract Generations.
- A ready or active Work references exactly one current **Contract Generation**; historical generations remain immutable and addressable.
- One **Contract Generation** owns exactly one Contract Root manifest and closes over exact typed Contract Component identities, schema versions, and content hashes.
- A Contract Component may be reused by several Contract Revisions or Generations, but each root independently pins its exact closure and meaning.
- Work lifecycle state and transition history are outside the Contract Root, while the root pins the lifecycle version whose semantics govern that state.
- An **Authority Requirement Snapshot** belongs inside the Contract Root; actual Principals, Grants, Delegations, Mandates, and Authorization Receipts remain outside.
- Publishing a candidate Contract Root requires authority bound to the Work, current draft revision or generation, semantic publication intent, and candidate hash; the resulting receipt cannot be part of the hash it authorizes.
- Every Packet, Action Spec, Lease, Run, Submission, Claim, Assessment, and authority evaluation whose meaning depends on the Work Contract binds one exact Contract Generation root.
- A material amendment creates a new Contract Revision and then a new Contract Generation; it never mutates a published generation.
- A Decision remains rationale outside the Contract Root. Only a resolved normative consequence represented in a Contract Component can change executable behavior.
- Carry-forward across Contract Generations requires one purpose-specific **Equivalence Receipt** for the exact old and new hashes; no satisfaction, Assessment, Lease, Submission, or authority applicability carries implicitly.
- **Presentation Metadata** cannot influence a Contract Root or be consumed by any domain or control-plane rule. Unknown metadata fails instead of becoming presentation data.
- Terminal Work has no candidate head and cannot publish another Contract Generation; correction or continuation creates linked successor Work.

- One active repository installation and Authority Epoch resolves exactly one active **Trust Root Snapshot**; root private material remains external.
- A **Principal** has zero or more Principal Bindings, Sessions, and Authority Grants, but none is implied by another.
- Every authoritative **Session** belongs to exactly one active Principal Binding and proves each canonical Action Request; Session ancestry records provenance and never transfers authority.
- The Contract Root contains one closed set of **Authority Requirement Snapshots** for governed actions; actual Principals, Sessions, Grants, Mandates, Revocations, and Authorization Receipts remain outside it.
- A genesis **Authority Grant** has no parent and may be created only by the bootstrap ceremony. Every other Grant has exactly one parent and exactly one **Delegation**.
- One parent Grant may issue zero or more child Grants, but every child is equal or narrower across actions, subjects, repository and Work scope, Contract Root, validity, budgets, uses, side effects, connector targets, and delegation depth.
- A Delegation cannot target a Principal in its ancestry, replenish an ancestor budget, duplicate one-shot capacity among siblings, or union partial Grant paths into wider authority.
- One **Authority Mandate** names exactly one verified human issuer, one carrier, one semantic action and exact subject closure, has maximum one use, and appears in at most one current-action Authorization Receipt.
- Every successful authority-bearing Action Request produces exactly one primary **Authorization Receipt** in the same SQLite transaction as local mutation, mandate or budget consumption, idempotency publication, and Action Result.
- An Action Request may cite an earlier Authorization Receipt only as an exact prerequisite fact. Live unrevoked Grants and available Mandates authorize the current action; the new Receipt is retrospective and non-bearer.
- An **Authority Revocation** targets exactly one authority record and invalidates its prospective descendants for future evaluation; it never erases or retroactively reauthorizes historical actions.
- Step execution Grants omit Work completion authority by default. Completion may require a distinct Principal, Session, tool, or Grant lineage and explicit quorum.
- One **Connector Credential Binding** resolves zero secret bytes into canonical state. Each outbound Effect Intent pins one exact binding revision, target, idempotency policy, Grant scope, and reconciliation contract.
- One **Effect Intent** may have several immutable attempt and observation records but only one current reconciled remote-state classification; an Authorization Receipt proves permission to attempt, not provider success.
- Restore or clone preserves Authorization Receipts as history but does not activate Sessions, prospective Grants, unconsumed Mandates, or connector authority unless the destination Authority Epoch and anti-rollback ceremony reauthorize them.

- A consumer Contract Generation owns zero or more **Work Requirements**; each Requirement targets exactly one same-repository Work and one exact published Contract Root.
- Every Work Requirement uses the closed predicate target Work completed at that exact root and exactly one **Requirement Enforcement Scope**: before execution, before one exact consumer Step revision, or before completion.
- A built-in **Requirement Gate** evaluates one exact Work Requirement component. The edge owns topology, the Gate owns pure satisfaction evaluation, and Projection alone derives blocks and runnable effects.
- Step dependency edges connect Step revisions inside exactly one Work. Cross-Work ordering never enters the Step DAG.
- Work Requirements compose as AND. OR or quorum is an explicit pinned composite over distinct Requirement Gate leaves, never edge order or labels.
- The published Work Requirement graph is self-edge-free and acyclic. Candidate publication checks the current graph plus the candidate root.
- A target root change, cancellation, supersession, absence, corruption, or retention failure never silently rebinds a Requirement. An authorized consumer amendment or purpose-specific Equivalence Receipt is required.
- Requirement satisfaction transfers no Claim, Observation, Assessment, authority, state, completion, or acceptance from target to consumer.
- A superseded Work has exactly one outgoing **SupersededBy** relation to its successor; one successor may receive zero or more such relations from replaced predecessors.
- SupersededBy is committed in the same transaction as the predecessor lifecycle transition and resulting Authorization Receipt linkage; concurrent successors cannot both win.
- **Corrects** and **Continues** are immutable acyclic lineage relations with no lifecycle cascade, latest implication, acceptance inheritance, dependent retargeting, or automatic Evidence invalidation.
- A **Work Reference** is directional and may cycle but cannot self-reference. It can appear in bounded inspection or navigation only and has no normative consumer.
- Every Work relation binds exact endpoint identities and observed roots or revisions, canonical direction, schema version, immutable reason and provenance, expected revisions, and idempotency.
- Relation candidate hashes exclude their future Authorization Receipts; the canonical action transaction joins the committed relation, state history where applicable, retrospective Receipt, and Action Result.
- Cross-repository prerequisites are represented by locally retained signed Evidence and pinned Gate evaluation, never a live Work Requirement.
- Retention preserves relation endpoints and history. Migration never promotes an ambiguous v1 blocker, parent, link, successor, or related edge into normative meaning.

- One active Store Generation, Authority Epoch, and Trust Root context pins exactly one Repository Governance Floor.
- Every executable Contract Root contains exactly one closed outgoing transition requirement and one closed incoming activation requirement; their current and candidate roles are never inferred from recency.
- Publishing an authority-policy amendment jointly satisfies the Repository Governance Floor, current outgoing transition requirement, and candidate incoming activation requirement. Equivalent clauses deduplicate but no branch substitutes for another.
- A semantic Authority Policy Diff classifies the exact transition before authorization. Weakening or incomparable change additionally consumes one exact nondelegable one-use human downgrade Mandate; invalid, unknown, unsatisfiable, or contradictory change blocks.
- Candidate-scoped Grants may be established before activation, but actual Principals, Grants, Mandates, and Receipts remain outside Contract Root hashes and do not make candidate policy live.
- First Work publication satisfies the active Repository Governance Floor plus the candidate incoming activation requirement. Repository genesis is a separate human-present bootstrap ceremony before either exists.
- Repository-floor or Trust Root rotation satisfies the current floor, proposed floor, and a predeclared continuity rule; weakening also consumes exact downgrade consent.
- Recovery uses the last trusted predeclared recovery requirement, destination floor, exact break-glass Mandate, exclusive generation lock, and an Authority Epoch advance. It is not candidate-only force.
- One publication transaction rechecks all transition requirements, revocation, expiry, budgets, quorum independence, and use counts; consumes any Mandate; and commits the Contract Generation, Store Generation reachability, Receipt, Action Result, and idempotency outcome atomically.

- A **Decision** belongs to exactly one **Work**, owns 1..N immutable **Decision Revisions**, and has exactly one current CAS head while open.
- One Decision Revision owns 2..N immutable mutually exclusive **Alternatives**. One **Resolution** selects exactly one Alternative; Other first appends a new revision and Alternative.
- Decision lifecycle is open with append-only revision, open to resolved, open to withdrawn, and resolved to superseded through one atomically resolved successor. No lifecycle path reopens, unlocks, or edits semantic history.
- A Resolution binds the exact revision, option and consequence hashes, subject and base hashes, rationale, rejection reasons, and Authorization Receipt. Its Mandate binds the authenticated prompt-to-option mapping and cannot be reused after revision.
- Resolution has zero direct effect on Contract, lifecycle, Gates, Steps, Conditions, Recipes, or Projections. Runtime consumers never select or interpret a Decision record.
- One separately authorized **Decision Materialization** joins one Resolution to exact before and candidate Contract Roots, changed component hashes, invalidation or Equivalence Receipts, and the amendment Action Request.
- One Resolution has 0..N materializations and one Contract Generation may materialize 0..N Resolutions. A stale base rejects unless exact purpose-specific equivalence proves applicability.
- Decision effect status is derived from materializations and active roots; it is not stored as another Decision lifecycle axis.
- One resolved Decision has at most one superseding successor and at most one predecessor; the graph is acyclic. Supersession preserves prior Contract effects until a new materialization and publication replace them.
- A Decision Batch Receipt covers 2..N independent Resolutions, is non-nesting, and commits all or none. Its Mandate enumerates every exact revision and selected Alternative hash.
- A terminal Work receives no new Decisions, supersessions, or materializations. Correction or continuation creates new Work.

- One stable **Step** identity belongs to exactly one **Work**, owns 1..N immutable **Step Revisions**, and appears at most once in one Step Graph Snapshot.
- Every published executable Contract Generation pins exactly one complete Step Graph Snapshot with 1..N required Step Bindings.
- Each Step Graph edge joins exact bindings in the same Work and snapshot and means the dependent requires the predecessor binding satisfied. Scheduling preference, wave, lane, and resource order are not edges.
- Step lifecycle, Step Lease, StepAttempt, Submission, and satisfaction apply to one exact **Step Binding**, not to a bare Step id or mutable current revision.
- Every **Run** has exactly one **ExecutionAttempt** owner: StepAttempt for Step execution, DispatchAttempt for connector dispatch, or ReconciliationAttempt for provider-truth acquisition.
- One **StepAttempt** binds one exact Step Binding and Step Lease fence and owns 0..N Step-execution Runs.
- One **DispatchAttempt** binds one durable Effect Intent and dispatch fence and owns 0..N dispatch Runs.
- One **ReconciliationAttempt** binds one durable Effect Intent and fresh authorized Action Request and owns 0..N reconciliation Runs.
- A dispatch or reconciliation origin-Step reference is immutable provenance only and grants no Lease, authority, Evidence applicability, lifecycle authority, or current-Step mutation right.
- A candidate amendment supplies a complete graph and a total **Amendment Disposition**. Old and new snapshots are authoritative; disposition is transition evidence outside the candidate root.
- Retention is one-to-one. Split or merge is remove plus add and never infers satisfaction, Evidence, authority, or lifecycle carry.
- Publishing a new Contract Root fences every prior-root Step mutation token. No Step Lease, StepAttempt, Step-execution Run, Submission, or satisfaction transfers automatically; dispatch and reconciliation records remain with the durable Effect Intent without inheriting current-root authority.
- Current execution continuation requires purpose-specific execution equivalence, a fresh authority evaluation, closure of the old Lease, and a new higher-fence Lease bound to the new root.
- Immutable Observations remain historical. Every current execution, satisfaction, Observation, Assessment, or authority applicability transfer requires its own exact **Carry-Forward Receipt**.
- Ready Work remains ready and active Work remains active after a valid amendment. A material amendment while awaiting_acceptance invalidates the completion Submission and returns Work to active atomically.
- Amendment publication, graph reachability, binding lineage, state transitions, fence advancement, invalidations, carry receipts, authorization, and Action Result commit in one transaction.
- An in-doubt **Effect Intent** survives Step removal and blocks blind retry or completion until explicit reconciliation, compensation, or proven unaffected disposition.

- One **Effect Intent** belongs to exactly one immutable **EffectIntentHomeV1** and exactly one immutable typed **Effect Origin**, and records exactly one originating Operation, Authorization Receipt, and Result as non-bearer provenance.
