#### Design revision reconciliation, Build Handoff and method classification

The effective head is `dec-canonical-vnext-recipe-catalog-and-v1-54bd`, which supersedes `dec-canonical-design-revision-9ed8` only to replace its obsolete Design-method classification. Every other 9ed8 Design Revision, closure, synthesis, reconciliation, finalization, Handoff, authority, migration, proof and reopen law is incorporated verbatim. Adversarial Review, Audit and Generate and Filter are governed Capability methods; Design Relay and Wayfinding are Orchestration Recipes.

##### Ownership and cardinality

Design is an optional authoring aggregate keyed by exactly one Work. A Work has zero or one Design stream; Design remains the stream's semantic owner. The stream is never another Work identity and owns no lifecycle, runtime policy, authority, implementation progress, or next action. Repository governance pins one Design Closure Requirement Snapshot before Design authoring or candidate publication. It declares the closed required slots, authority and Evidence for not_applicable, and any bounded explicit no-Design exemption. No-Design is design_root:none plus exact policy, reason, Evidence, and source bindings; absence is invalid and an agent cannot choose it opportunistically.

##### Revision and closure model

A stream appends immutable content-addressed Design Revisions through one CAS candidate head. Genesis has no parent; every later Revision has exactly one. Canonical identity uses a versioned domain-separated encoding over repository installation, Work, parent, closure requirement, Design Slot Manifest, typed Design Source Bindings, appendix roots, and exact referenced versions. Created or sealed time, actor display data, adapter fields, and invocation observations stay outside semantic identity. One competing writer wins; a stale submission remains recoverable Staging Input.

The Design Slot Manifest gives every required slot exactly one disposition: satisfied, authorized not_applicable, or missing. Appendices are hashed non-authoritative context and cannot satisfy a slot, create acceptance, proof, authority, or behavior.

The full Decision Closure Manifest covers every Work-owned Decision head and revision, terminal status, Resolution, supersession edge, consequence classification, all N:M Materializations, and derived effect status including superseded_but_effect_live. An explicit no_contract_effect closes rationale-only decisions. Open material choices, unresolved conflict, unapplied normative effect, stale or partial materialization, or missing effect-live coverage blocks closure.

Every material candidate Contract Component has total typed provenance to one exact Design slot/source binding, authorized no-Design source binding, or Decision Materialization. No semantic engine interprets narrative into a Component.

##### Synthesis and reconciliation

Design Synthesis and Design Reconciliation are pure deterministic Projections over one coherent exact snapshot token closing over Design or no-Design root; closure requirement; complete Decision closure; candidate Contract Root and component provenance; Capability Census; candidate acceptance, non-goals and affected areas; human and agent journeys; migration, quarantine, activation, rollback and removal matrices; stages and proof gates; risks, unknowns and reopen conditions; review and edge-sweep Evidence; freshness roots; and canonicalization versions.

Reconciliation performs typed mechanical checks only. A semantic reviewer produces Evidence against an exact subject and freshness bound. Reconciliation never creates Tasks or Steps, changes Contract, materializes Decisions, plans work, writes lifecycle, or treats advisor agreement as truth.

##### Finalization, Handoff, and applicability

A seal request reruns closure against the exact snapshot and rechecks every material head and root in one transaction or equivalent deterministic compare-before-commit protocol. Clean closure writes one immutable content-addressed Design Finalization Manifest. It binds all closure inputs, deterministic synthesis, full scope and exclusions, Decision/materialization and Contract provenance, census and journeys, migration/rollback/removal, stage/proof matrix, reviews and edge sweep, risks and recovery bounds, policy and canonicalization versions, and immutable freshness references.

valid_until is the deterministic minimum of every applicable pinned bound. A generated as_of, rendered timestamp, mutable file, adapter field, or ambient latest selector never enters identity. Identical reseal returns the same manifest. Any input change leaves history intact and makes current applicability false. There is no stored incomplete, reconciled, finalized, stale, handoff-current, or approval-ready state.

Build Handoff is a bounded Projection rendering of one Design Finalization Manifest. It owns no state, canonical latest, authority, recommendation, or next action. The current Agent Packet alone advertises publication, inspection, repair, or stop.

##### Approval and publication

Build approval is one exact nondelegable one-use Authority Mandate. A trusted host or local ceremony binds the authenticated human, exact prompt and choice, carrier, repository installation, Store Generation, Authority Epoch, Work, Design or no-Design root, Decision and Materialization hashes, candidate Contract Root, Design Finalization Manifest, approved full scope and exclusions, stage/proof set, nonce, and expiry.

Trusted time and every root recheck at issuance and use. Only initial Contract publication plus draft-to-ready or exact amendment publication may consume the Mandate. The same transaction also satisfies the repository floor, current outgoing requirement when present, and candidate incoming requirement. No approval flag or separate build transition exists. Failure or stale state consumes nothing; identical replay is idempotent; conflicting reuse rejects. The Mandate grants no Lease, Step execution, connector, reconciliation, completion, delivery, release, retention, migration, or recovery authority.

##### Terminal, migration, and removal

Terminal Work rejects active Design head changes and new current finalization. Historical import may retain records without activating them. v1 migration freezes writers and preserves every observable byte, path, mode, hash, order, parse result, physical home, and provenance. Already absent or transformed history is reported unless a verified backup survives. Divergent design/spec, invalid encoding, duplicate DB/workbench sources, unknown ownership or ordering, and uncertain authority quarantine.

Legacy Feature fields, design/spec/notes/handoff/research/qa/witness/advisor/worktree files, DecisionSet source approval and advisor text, reconcile receipts, actor labels, go text, freshness markers, and prior approvals are provenance only. None creates current Design, Resolution, Materialization, Contract effect, Mandate, or Handoff. The v1 mutable sidecars, fallback reader, reconcile apply-plan, handoff checksum authority, finalize state, and prepare/accept handoff gates are removed after importer, adapter, and rollback proof.

##### Design proof and reopen

Proof must cover canonical bytes and hashes across platform, ordering, Unicode and export/restore; required and explicitly exempt no-Design paths; two-writer CAS with recoverable losing input; appendix smuggling; total component provenance; rationale-only, unapplied, stale, overlapping N:M and superseded-but-effect-live Decision closure; seal races against every root and freshness change; idempotent reseal; semantic-review Evidence expiry; terminal rejection; stale-Handoff non-authority at publication and closeout; exact Mandate spoof, carrier, nonce, replay, expiry, revocation, cross-repository, cross-Work, stale-root, double-spend and crash cases; initial and amendment publication; adapter parity; and fixture-total lossless-at-import migration including prior-loss reports.

Reopen if legitimate closure requires Design to own runtime policy or next action; coherent finalization cannot avoid a second lifecycle or mutable latest record; a material Contract Component cannot have total typed provenance; a supported approval carrier cannot attest exact human and subjects; or bounded no-Design work cannot stay explicit, policy-governed, and fail-closed.

#### Projection Recipe and bounded continuation

Effective `dec-correct-canonical-submission-claim-a13b` incorporates the 3905 H3 baseline, d21e, d116, the immutable 7138 body SHA-256 `e028cc54e9e4f9d15d80775cf63441e674d47db1bee44a0528c4c65ae16856c4` and its 7c1b/e897 Projection/Recipe laws; neither 3905 nor a13b changes those public packet-read bytes or semantics. The incorporated 7138 law closes the previously unreachable public acquisition path with explicit discovery, a distinct fact-bound bootstrap read and a required Packet recipe binding while preserving the two-read-only-MCP/CLI-execution boundary. It rejects pre-Packet `JobRecipeEligibilityV1`, a public Frontier Receipt, reuse of a prior Packet Frontier, ambient Recipe defaults and private Skill state. ##### Canonical pipeline

```text
McpPacketReadRequestV1
  mode = DiscoverSelectionContextV1
          -> complete SelectionContextV1 with 30 options
       | BootstrapNoRecipeV1
          -> exact BootstrapRouteFactViewV1 or typed refusal
       | ProjectV1(RecipeSelectionRequestV1)
          |
          v
ProjectionQuery
  repository installation + Store Generation
  coherent snapshot + trusted time + view + bounds
  scope = Work | Repository
  RecipeSelectionRequestV1
    primary_selection = Absent | Present(exact one of nine Primary Recipes)
    continuation_selection = Absent | Present(BoundedContinuation, attended | unattended)
          |
          v
ActionFrontier
  eligible frozen ActionSpecV1 members
  blockers + Conditions + inspect candidates
  material dependency stamps + live guards + audit context
  complete proven WaveRefs
          |
          v
Projection seals RecipeApplicationV1
  frontier_ref = exact ActionFrontier hash
  primary + continuation = exact request selections
          |
          +--> optional Primary Advice --------+
          +--> optional Continuation Advice ---+--> deterministic restrictive meet
          |
          v
Final Projection
  validates Application and Advice against same Frontier
  applies core stops and fresh SchedulingAssessment when required
          |
          v
Action | complete Wave | planning_required | Inspect | Wait | Stop
          |
          v
bounded AgentPacket
  required PacketRecipeBindingV1
    selection-request hash
    exact application by value/hash
    ordered 0..2 component provenance
    composed Advice provenance
```

Action Frontier is an internal stage of the single Projection. It is not a public Packet, queue, reservation, store or recommendation owner. Before the later total inventory freeze there is no runtime ActionSpecV1 and no candidate leaf may be advertised.

##### Scope and staleness

Work scope binds one focal Work and complete material closure. Repository scope canonically manifests the separate Work, Contract Root, Gate Snapshot, Step and relation, authority, capability, scheduling and resource facts needed for its recommendation. It creates no repository Work, root, lifecycle, Gate, acceptance, authority, batch, queue, scheduler or synthetic transaction boundary.

The Packet semantic hash closes the full rendered result for audit and adapter parity. It is not repository-wide CAS. Every Action Spec has one complete subject-scoped Material Dependency Stamp, including relevant positive and negative facts, plus live guards. Its Store Generation, Authority Epoch, schema and core versions, trusted valid_until and leaf-specific dependency closure define request staleness. Audit-only context never stales a request and proven-unrelated commits do not serialize independent members.

Bounds may limit candidate summaries only. They never truncate guards, blockers, authority requirements, material dependencies or wave membership. If the bound omits any candidate capable of changing the result, Projection returns a non-actionable inspect, planning_required, wait or stop result.

##### Recipe contract

`RecipeManifestV1` is the exact ordered semantic tuple `[recipe_id, semantic_version, recipe_role, purpose_guidance_resource_ref, trigger_projection_reason_refs, required_contract_refs, restrictive_operation_filter_program_ref, phase_guidance_resource_refs, required_projection_predicate_refs, hard_stop_predicate_refs, completion_predicate_refs, return_reason_refs, operating_limit_program_ref, allowed_continuation_profile_refs]`. The nine non-Continuation entries are `Primary`; only `bounded-continuation` is `ContinuationOverlay`. Phase guidance is the exact six-tuple Perceive, Choose, Act, Observe, Learn, Continue. Every set is finite, canonically sorted and duplicate-free; its bound is the exact row count of the backward catalog bound by the enclosing Bundle/Release. Unknown fields/tags, cardinality errors, overflow, unsupported versions, missing/forward/self/cyclic references and shadowing fail closed.

ResourceDescriptorV1 and the Release closure own content identity, provenance, license, compatibility, dependencies, disposition, migration, removal and proof. RecipeManifestV1 contains no self identity, job, Capability reference, direct Observation/Assessment/Authority dependency or install state. It uses allowlisted Projection predicates. The later Capability-owned `JobRecipeEligibilityV1` references exact Recipe Resource identities in the allowed dependency direction; it does not participate in application or Projection.

`RecipeSelectionRequestV1` is the exact tuple `[schema_version=1, resolution_basis_ref, primary_selection, continuation_selection]`. The Primary selection is `Absent | Present([exact_primary_recipe_resource_ref, exact_primary_manifest_content_ref])`; the Continuation selection is `Absent | Present([exact_bounded_continuation_resource_ref, exact_bounded_continuation_manifest_content_ref, exact_attended_or_unattended_profile_resource_ref])`. It contains no `frontier_ref`, Packet/JobRoute reference, authority, Receipt, nonce, cursor, retry, time, latest selector, fallback or caller applicability claim. Both absent is required core orientation, never an omitted default.

After the coherent read constructs the Frontier, Projection seals `RecipeApplicationV1` as the unchanged exact tuple `[schema_version=1, resolution_basis_ref, frontier_ref, primary, continuation]`. The request/application optionals form a total bijection of exactly `10 x 3 = 30` legal shapes. Bounded Continuation cannot be Primary; no primary list, second overlay, nesting, import, transition, priority, first-match, ambient latest or fallback exists. Every present component resolves inside the same exact Release/catalog/compatibility basis and same Frontier. Missing, invalid, stale, mismatched, incompatible, shadowed or overflowed material returns a typed refusal before Packet rather than falling back. A selected-but-NotApplicable component returns a non-actionable Packet whose binding preserves the exact selection, application and component outcome; it never degrades to Absent. Exact Present chooses one identity; automatic candidate selection is not implied. `JobRecipeEligibilityV1` remains strictly post-Selected-JobRoute and never participates in the request, application, Frontier, Projection, Packet or route.

Each present component yields `NotApplicable | RestrictiveAdvice | HardStop`. HardStop dominates. Otherwise allowsets and permissions intersect; preconditions conjoin; hard stops, prohibitions and denylists union; comparable limits with identical scope/unit/owner/reset take the minimum; validity takes the earliest bound; and contradiction, incomparable limits, unknown input or empty frontier becomes HardStop. Primary Advice may narrow/order existing opportunities, prefer one indivisible WaveRef, select presentation guidance and tighten limits. Bounded Continuation may restrict allowsets, cadence, continuation, limits and hard stops only; it cannot order, prefer a Wave, select phase, choose an Operation or recommend. Neither may create or modify Action Specs, inputs, readiness, blockers, DAG, Work Requirements, Gate or Assessment truth, authority, automatic safety, effect, idempotency or retry class, material dependencies, overlap facts, provider scope or wave membership.

The declarative language is content-addressed, total and bounded. It has no writes, I/O, recursion, unbounded collection, ambient time, randomness, callbacks, arbitrary commands, external model judgment or nondeterministic primitive. Its output is Advice and can be ignored or rejected by final Projection; it never becomes Recommendation.

##### Public Packet-read and Recipe-binding contract [dec-canonical-recipe-selection-and-packet-7138]

`McpPacketReadRequestV1` is `[schema_version, request_id, repository_locator, authenticated_host_connection_context_ref, projection_scope, expected_release_ref, expected_public_catalog_ref, bounded_response_redaction_profile, read_mode]`. `projection_scope` is exactly `Repository | Work(exact_work_ref)`. `read_mode` is exactly `BootstrapNoRecipeV1 | DiscoverSelectionContextV1 | ProjectV1(recipe_selection_request)`. Unknown, omitted, multiple or mode-incompatible fields refuse. The identical CLI fallback exposes the same modes.

`DiscoverSelectionContextV1` succeeds only against one coherent active-Store Release and Orchestration-catalog closure. It returns `SelectionContextV1 = [schema_version=1, resolution_basis_ref, selection_options]`, where `selection_options` is the complete canonical ordered 10 x 3 product of `RecipeSelectionOptionV1 = [primary_selection, continuation_selection]`: Primary `Absent` plus nine exact Primary identities crossed with Continuation `Absent | attended | unattended`. Every Present value carries exact Resource, manifest-content and profile refs. The order is not priority or default; the branch has no Frontier, applicability, Work choice, JobRoute, Recommendation, authority, Receipt, nonce, cursor, cache, retry or state and cannot truncate.

`BootstrapNoRecipeV1` is legal only in exact no_store or pre_store bootstrap under Repository scope. It creates no selection request, Frontier or application. One coherent owner-fact read produces `BootstrapRouteFactViewV1 = [schema_version=1, bootstrap_context, resolution_basis_ref, ordered_source_fact_commitments, fact_view_hash]`; Integration transports the commitments but owns none of their meanings. Its successful envelope is `NoActiveStore` with that exact view. A discovery/project `NoActiveStore` has no bootstrap facts or Recipe values. Store absence alone never selects Setup; the shared JobRoute resolver must validate the view. Active Store returns Stale for bootstrap mode.

`McpPacketReadEnvelopeV1` is exactly `Packet | SelectionContext | NoActiveStore | Unavailable | Stale | Incompatible`. Only `Packet`, and only after `ProjectV1`, carries exactly one required `PacketRecipeBindingV1 = [schema_version=1, selection_request_hash, recipe_application, recipe_application_hash, component_provenance, advice_provenance]`. `PacketRecipeComponentProvenanceV1` is the ordered zero-to-two list of `[component_role: Primary | Continuation, recipe_return_occurrence_ref, component_output_hash]`. `PacketRecipeAdviceProvenanceV1` is `[advice_outcome: CoreOnly | NotApplicable | RestrictiveAdvice | HardStop, ordered_component_output_hashes, composed_output_hash]`. Core has zero component rows; one component has one matching row; two components are exactly Primary then Continuation. HardStop dominates. The application, component rows, Advice, final Projection result and Packet semantic hash bind the same Frontier.

Discovery and Project are independent pure reads, not a Frontier receipt or retry protocol. Project revalidates all copied identities; catalog/fact drift is Stale, mixed or unsupported Release is Incompatible, missing/ambiguous closure is Unavailable and no active Store is NoActiveStore. No branch substitutes a Recipe/profile, degrades Present to Absent, changes mode or retries. `tools/list` remains exactly `{maestro_packet, maestro_cli_search}`; CLI executes governed Operations; no Packet branch carries JobRoute or JobGuidance.

Selected carries one of Setup, Research, Design, Review, Execute, Recover or Adapt; one closed reason; one exact job Resource; zero methods; and zero Recipes. Method, child, example and Recipe disclosure occurs only after route selection through the separately owned Capability and Orchestration relations below.

Resolution validates identity first, permits Setup alone before Packet from separately proven bootstrap facts, gives Recover precedence over every explicit read request, permits only read-only Research/Review override, then applies the total Packet-reason map. ##### Review mode, invocation and Evidence boundary [dec-canonical-capability-skill-resource-831a, incorporating a405]

`ReviewModeV1` is the tagged five-member sum `Inspect | Audit | AdversarialReview | QAReplay | CloseReview`. Capability resolves it only after JobRoute selects Review using `GateRequirement | ExplicitMode | InspectDefault`; exact input and same-Release Resource validation occurs first. The primary relation is Inspect -> absent, Audit -> Audit, AdversarialReview -> AdversarialReview, QAReplay -> QAReplay and CloseReview -> CloseReview. Conflicting Gate requirements are Ambiguous; request/policy conflict and stale, incompatible or unavailable closure are Blocked. No mode or compound intent enters JobRoute, Packet, MCP, RecipeApplication or OperationResult.

The global auxiliary set is exactly ArchitectureReview, GenerateAndFilter and Verification. Audit admits any subset of all three; CloseReview admits only optional Verification; Inspect, AdversarialReview and QAReplay admit none. This is exactly four mode/auxiliary edges and eleven non-edges. Across all forty mode x auxiliary-subset shapes, exactly thirteen admit and twenty-seven refuse: Inspect one, Audit eight, AdversarialReview one, QAReplay one and CloseReview two. ArchitectureReview is only an Audit specialization; GenerateAndFilter is only an Audit candidate-discovery technique under a fixed prior rubric; Verification is only an Audit falsification or CloseReview proof-closure technique.

`ReviewMethodLoadPlanV1 = [primary_method_resource_ref=Absent|Present, unique canonically ordered auxiliary_method_resource_refs]`. The plan is unique, minimal, dependency-closed, current and same-Release. Auxiliaries execute inside the one primary invocation, emit no independent invocation or five-mode result and own no publication. Direct auxiliary invocation, an absent typed need, an extra auxiliary or a non-edge is Blocked.

`ReviewMethodInvocationV1 = Produced(ReviewMethodResultV1) | Refused(ReviewMethodRefusalV1) | Failed(ReviewMethodFailureV1)`. Produced has one schema-valid matching mode payload. Refused is a conclusive semantic refusal with no review content. Failed is a conclusive exact-invocation-bound inability to produce a conforming payload and has no `ReviewMethodResultV1`; it is not row Error, Assessment error, Evidence, Gate truth, OperationResult, retry permission or effect uncertainty. Advice that crosses classes, removes every mandatory containment or deadline-safe top-class opportunity, edits a Wave, or defeats the Safety Floor is rejected or ignored. Projection then uses the core stable comparator and alone emits Action, complete Wave, planning_required, Inspect, Wait, or Stop.

Work-scoped Packets, Proposals, Scheduling Assessments, Recipes, adapters, and clients cannot be combined into a repository Recommendation. Replanning is a fresh bounded evaluation. Cadence remains Recipe or external-client guidance. Model generation stays outside the evaluator; privacy consent, minimization, and redaction precede egress, any Maestro-managed call follows Effect Intent, and retained material pins model, prompt, source, consent, redaction, and retention provenance.

##### Migration, proof, and reopen

Migration preserves every priority label, P-number, display rank, risk or deadline prose, lane, order, wave, implicit dependency, Recipe priority, route score, recommendation, prompt, advisor output, Work Lease, TUI priority, timestamp, policy-like file, and custom source byte with path, mode, order, hash, and provenance. It activates none as policy, Binding, Proposal, disposition, Scheduling Assessment, deadline, harm finding, fairness episode, dependency, reservation, authority, queue, cursor, or Recommendation. Exact Contract facts require reconstructable subjects and semantics plus fresh publication authority. Restore and destination activation preserve Planning bytes as history and repeat initial Binding publication under destination governance.

Proof covers record ownership and forbidden edges; Proposal immutability, dispositions, deduplication, overflow and erasure; scheduling-participant completeness and self-exclusion; Binding CAS and authority races; malicious authority fields and restrictive policies; semantic classification and downgrade Mandate replay; Safety Floor mutants and core evolution; active-harm freshness and no-containment; full foundation bounds and elapsed slack; fairness arrivals, occupancy, identity resets, overload and passive-driver limits; deterministic permutations; Recipe precedence; no preemption; all root, topology, Proposal, Observation, authority, resource, Lease, Effect, policy and time races; same-key Assessment integrity; unrelated-change survival; adapter parity; deterministic export and restore; and fixture-total non-promoting migration. Architecture guards forbid scheduler, queue, cursor, reservation, dispatcher, mutable plan, hidden retry, I/O evaluator, client Recommendation, and adapter-private ranking.

Shared public and wire names plus all 145 Action leaves are locked semantically; exact efa0 successor bytes remain a Stage-0 gate. Trusted-time realization, policy numeric values, supported duration-distribution implementations, concrete resource measurements and optional external-client replan cadence remain bounded implementation inputs; they may not reduce scope or alter the locked semantics. Reopen if correctness requires a second Recommendation owner; queue, cursor, reservation, preemption, direct owner-state mutation, model or network I/O in evaluation, candidate participation in its own authority, a fairness service guarantee despite an external driver, or any material scheduling fact that cannot remain exact, provenance-bound, reproducible, bounded, and fail-closed.

#### Coordination and Inbox

Locked by dec-canonical-coordination-and-inbox-model-5901 after two independent adversarial reviews and one fresh cardinality tie-break.

##### Ownership boundary

Coordination is one closed advisory algebra. It owns immutable fixed-audience Thread Descriptors; Coordination Addresses; immutable Messages and closed Message Content; per-Principal Message Acknowledgements; Focus and Scope Declarations and Withdrawals; Conflict Assert and Resolve Message semantics; Handoff semantics; and Delivery Subject meaning. Projection owns Presence and Inbox. Execution owns Effect Intent, DispatchAttempt, ReconciliationAttempt, remediation and Remote Classification. Evidence owns filesystem and provider Observations and Assessments. Authority owns Principal, Session, eligibility and every current permission. Coordination owns no Work or Step identity, relation, lifecycle, acceptance, completion, Gate, authority, Lease, assignment, queue, worker, retry, remote truth, next action, physical liveness, Worktree aggregate or Git cleanup.

##### Address, audience and Thread

CoordinationAddress is exactly:

- PrincipalAddress with one PrincipalId;
- WorkAddress with one RepositoryInstallationId and WorkId; or
- RepositoryAddress with one RepositoryInstallationId.

Session, Step, Lease, checkout, path, provider, transport, Card and arbitrary strings cannot be addresses. Address possession identifies no entitlement. Publish, read, acknowledge and delivery origination each receive a separate current Authority evaluation.

A Thread Descriptor has one immutable nonempty canonically ordered audience. Every audience member binds one address plus an exact Audience Eligibility Snapshot reference and hash sufficient to identify the Principals intended at publication time. That snapshot is historical non-bearer evidence, never current permission. PrincipalAddress eligibility must match the exact Principal. Work and Repository audience eligibility never derives from related links, parentage, claims, Focus, Scope, Session activity or address possession.

Any audience change creates a new Thread. The first publication atomically creates the Thread, first Message, Authorization Receipt, Action Result and idempotency record. Empty pre-created Threads are invalid. Later publication binds the exact Thread identity, revision and audience hash.

##### Message and acknowledgement

Every Message has one stable minted identity; versioned canonical semantic and content hashes; one total Store commit sequence plus transaction ordinal; exact Thread and audience hash; authenticated author Principal plus Session provenance; one Message Content variant; and exact typed subject references.

Message Content is exactly Information, Question, Proposal, Handoff, ConflictAssert, ConflictResolve or Intervention at this contract version. A Message may bind at most one reply-to and one correction-of reference, both exact same-Thread same-audience Message id and hash. Replies and corrections carry no behavior: they never rewrite, hide, retarget, supersede or change visibility of prior bytes, and concurrent corrections may coexist. Cross-audience references fail closed. Timestamp is audit material only.

One Message has zero or one Message Acknowledgement per acknowledging Principal. The identity is MessageId plus PrincipalId. via_address, exact audience hash and Audience Eligibility Snapshot reference are mandatory eligibility evidence but never make several acknowledgements for the same Principal. The handler rechecks historical eligibility plus current authorization. The fact means only that the Principal explicitly marked the exact Message bytes seen. It proves no delivery, comprehension, agreement, consent, Mandate, Handoff acceptance, Work or repository acknowledgement, Gate satisfaction, completion, ownership, assignment or queue progress. Semantic reads are pure and persist no cursor.

##### Focus, Scope and Presence

A Focus Declaration is immutable advisory orientation by one authenticated Principal and Session toward exactly one WorkRef or generation-scoped StepBindingRef. At most one Focus is currently applicable per RepositoryInstallationId, PrincipalId and SessionId.

A Scope Declaration is immutable advisory path intention by the same actor context and contains one or more distinct Scope Atoms. ScopeAtom is CheckoutId, normalized path and Exact or Subtree extent. Branch, base, head, target and commit are Handoff references, not Scope. Zero or more Scope Declarations may be concurrently applicable for one actor context.

Each declaration uses a half-open valid_from to valid_until interval and has zero or one explicit Withdrawal. Expiry is derived at trusted as_of and causes no write. Session Presence, staleness or termination never expires or withdraws it. ReplaceFocus with expected-current CAS atomically withdraws the old Focus when present and appends the new declaration; one concurrent replacement wins. WithdrawFocus, PublishScope and WithdrawScope are separate candidate actions. Concurrent Scope publications coexist.

Focus, Scope and their derived overlap create no Lease, reservation, assignment, owner, blocker, cleanup gate, authority, Evidence applicability, physical-overlap proof or next action.

Presence is a pure versioned as_of Condition over exact pinned activity signals and policy. It has no current head and is rendered separately from Authority Session validity. It may orient inspection but cannot select an authorized endpoint, prove life, death, quiescence, ownership, Lease validity, takeover safety, delivery or permission. Missing, stale, conflicting or bounded-away signals remain explicit.

##### Conflict and Handoff

Conflict has one canonical representation inside Message Content. Each ConflictId has exactly one ConflictAssert Message and zero or one successful ConflictResolve Message. Resolve binds the ConflictId, exact Assert Message id and hash, expected unresolved state, one closed resolution kind, explanation and optional exact Evidence references.

Same-key replay returns the original Resolve. Concurrent different-key resolution requests race expected-state CAS; one commits and the loser returns already_resolved or stale with the winning Resolve reference and records no second Resolve Message. Concurrent assertions use different ConflictIds and coexist. Conflict is current exactly when Assert exists and Resolve does not. Session staleness, Presence, expiry, silence, terminal Work, acknowledgement, correction or retention visibility never resolves it. New disagreement creates a new ConflictId.

Conflict alone never blocks Work, Step, Projection, cleanup, dispatch or authority. A blocker exists only when an independently owned Contract, Gate, Evidence, Execution, resource or safety fact makes the concern material.

Handoff is the Handoff Message variant with exact subject, Contract, Step Binding, branch, base, head, target, destination, concern, commit and Evidence references as applicable. It transfers no Lease, Grant, Mandate, Work owner, Contract, acceptance, completion, lifecycle, applicability or execution tenure. Acknowledgement is not acceptance. Continuation begins from a fresh canonical Projection and independently authorized Action Request and Lease acquisition when required.

##### Inbox

Inbox is one bounded pure authorized Projection over immutable Thread audiences, Messages, Message Acknowledgements, current authorization, exact snapshot and trusted as_of. It stores no Inbox item, cursor, queue, assignment, priority, retry, hidden unread state or lifecycle.

Ordering uses total Store order. Stateless pagination binds authenticated Principal, query hash, exact snapshot, bounds and ordering. Overflow reports has_more plus an exact continuation token and never appears empty or cleared. Work terminal state does not rewrite audience. Revocation may deny future reads but cannot undo information already observed.

##### Local publication and remote delivery

Local publication and remote delivery origination are separate atomic boundaries.

1. PublishInitialMessage or PublishMessage commits Coordination truth only.
2. OriginateCoordinationDelivery is Execution-owned. It validates the committed Message and exact Delivery Subject, then atomically publishes one Effect Intent plus dispatch reservation for the exact MessageId, logical recipient, DeliverySubject and purpose-hash tuple.
3. Connector I/O occurs outside SQLite through the locked dispatch protocol.
4. Remote response enters as Observation and classification through the locked effect protocol.

One Message may source zero or more delivery Intents, one per exact tuple. A crash between steps one and two leaves a valid local-only Message. It infers no delivery intent, appends no fallback copy and claims no remote success. Once an Intent exists, prepared, dispatch, in_doubt, reconciliation, remediation and same-key replay follow the Effect Intent laws. An adapter may not send remote-first or perform automatic local fallback after ambiguous transport.

Detailed Delivery Subject variants and final visibility-policy grammar remain bounded later design details. They cannot weaken immutable audience, current authorization, semantic uniqueness, publication-before-delivery or Execution ownership.

##### Worktree disposition

vNext has no Coordination-owned Worktree aggregate.

- checkout and path intention maps to Scope Declaration;
- branch, base, head, target, expected destination, concern and commit context maps to Handoff;
- checkout existence, ref state, head, dirty state, merge result, verification, deletion and prune outcome maps to Evidence;
- a governed merge or Contract-required cleanup is ordinary Step execution under one current StepLease-StepAttempt;
- ungoverned Git worktree mechanics and physical cleanup remain an external staged orchestration pattern.

merge_owner, claim_synthesis, next-owner rules, Card claims and actor strings are removed as authority and ownership. Cleanup eligibility may use current Lease, fence, resource and fresh Evidence facts. Focus, Scope, Handoff, Presence, acknowledgement and unresolved Conflict never block cleanup. A future first-class checkout manager requires a separate staged-filesystem Decision before ActionSpecV1 and cannot enter through Coordination.

##### Candidate actions and pure reads

Candidate Coordination mutation jobs are PublishInitialMessage, PublishMessage, AcknowledgeMessage, ReplaceFocus, WithdrawFocus, PublishScope, WithdrawScope, AssertConflict and ResolveConflict. OriginateCoordinationDelivery remains Execution-owned. Exact frozen leaf names remain pending ActionSpecV1.

Thread inspection, Message history, semantic read, Inbox, Presence, overlap and Conflict currentness are pure reads. No link, claim, accept-Handoff, assignment, read-cursor, queue, worktree-owner, cleanup-block, remote-first send, fallback-copy or Coordination delivery-classification action exists.

##### Retention, restore and migration

Ordinary retention and narrow security erasure use their separately governed protocols. Legal hold and pending or in_doubt delivery may pin required records. Authorized erasure retains a non-secret tombstone and destroys only the minimum secret-bearing bytes; low-entropy secret hashes are forbidden. Remote-copy erasure is another separately authorized Effect Intent and Maestro claims nothing without conclusive Observation.

Restore or clone advances Store Generation and Authority Epoch. It preserves historical Messages, Acknowledgements, tombstones and unresolved Intents but activates no Session, Grant, Focus, Scope, Conflict currentness, Presence, delivery, dispatch, cleanup authority or prospective permission. Destination-authorized reconciliation never redispatches automatically.

v1 migration freezes writers and dispatchers and preserves exact bytes, paths, modes, hashes, line order, ties, truncation, corruption, parse results, missing ids, headers, link-hidden history, cursors, clears, malformed events, claims, actors, worktree ledgers, receipts and fallback ambiguity. Missing ids receive migration-only source-derived identity, never semantic deduplication. Feature broadcast quarantines unless historical audience is provable. Cursors are hints, not Acknowledgements. A clear becomes historical Resolve only with exact Assert pairing. Session staleness never resolves Conflict. Claims, links, ownership strings, Presence events, URLs, commands, open receipts and fallback_local never become authority, owner, relation, Ack, delivery success, Effect Intent, Resolve, cleanup gate or retry safety. Ambiguous delivery remains opaque or in_doubt. Current declarations, Evidence, execution tenure and authority must be reacquired after activation. There is no dual write or legacy fallback.

##### Coordination proof and reopen

Proof covers closed address, audience, content and subject unions; immutable audience and new-audience-new-Thread; initial Thread plus Message atomicity; stable identity and total order; audience privacy and revocation; multi-address acknowledgement and seen-only noninterference; pure reads; Focus CAS, expiry and Session races; concurrent Scope publication and withdrawal; Presence non-authority; Conflict assertion and one-winner resolution; Handoff replay and stale references; stateless bounded Inbox; Message-before-Intent-before-I/O crash injection; semantic uniqueness, no fallback duplicate and in_doubt reconciliation; worktree normalization and absence of Coordination-derived cleanup blockers; retention, erasure, restore, clone, deterministic export, fixture-total migration and rollback; and semantic parity across CLI, JSON, MCP, TUI, hooks, skills and connectors.

Reopen only if immutable audience eligibility cannot preserve privacy without mutable membership; legitimate coordination requires assignment, authority transfer, blocking or a queue; one Conflict needs several successful semantic resolutions; local and remote publication require one all-or-none product promise; a separate local delivery identity proves semantics distinct from Effect Intent; or correct checkout management requires a first-class Maestro filesystem aggregate.

#### Consent alternative join inheritance

Decision c345 inherits 6252 slot identity and no-occupancy, 8ca2 alternative Mandates, cc17 candidate normalization and SelectionBasisCommitment, 73be/ef04 ranking and attribution, 18b0/f100 nominal debit conservation, and 655d/b6d2 selected-only all-or-none success. It supersedes none and adds no concrete producer or runtime.

#### Consent alternative join boundary

ConsentAlternativeUniverseCommitmentV1 binds the exact context, target, opaque effective obligation and slot set, fulfillment-producer protocol/hash, all canonical distinct Mandate support edges, unary and combination-validity commitments, availability/provenance revisions, totality witness, bounds and digest. ConsentCoverageFragmentV1 and MandateDebitFragmentV1 exist for every candidate before selection. ConsentWitnessJoinV1 composes those fragments with Grant, quorum and bounded-root requirements. Existing cc17 normalizes, 73be/ef04 select, and existing SelectionBasisCommitment plus SelectedWitnessSetCommitment record the basis and winner. SelectedMandateConsumptionProjectionV1 is MandateAtoms of the selected DebitMap only.

#### Consent alternative non-Evidence boundary

Evidence may provide immutable Observations and Assessments used by the later fulfillment producer, including provenance and revocation facts. Evidence never asserts universe completeness, eligibility, independence, selection, consumption, refund or authority. Missing, conflicting or stale Evidence makes the owning Authority derivation unavailable.

#### Consent alternative persistence boundary

Persistence may store content-addressed universe, coverage, debit, basis, selected-witness and consumption commitments only as records of owning Authority Actions. It cannot complete a finite list by querying rows, select by order, reserve a Mandate, infer occupancy, create a slot lifecycle or refund consumption. Hash or preimage mismatch is an integrity fault; an old universe remains immutable history and cannot be relabeled current.

#### Consent alternative Authority ownership refinement

Authority alone produces or validates the total alternative universe, maps its opaque support edges into the canonical witness algebra and revalidates selected Mandate availability at the later semantic point. Cc17, 73be and ef04 retain exclusive normalization, selection and attribution ownership. C345 owns no target catalog, role catalog, fulfillment eligibility, transaction or carrier. Missing 11A2, 11A3, 11B-FE1, 11B-FE2, row-12 or final ActionSpec material keeps every consumer unavailable.

#### Consent alternative constitutional refinement

No extension, adapter, Recipe, requester, provider or candidate policy may supply a preferred Mandate subset, order, fallback, per-slot winner, occupancy, reservation, independence assertion or totality claim. A new consent obligation or fulfillment grammar requires versioned core evolution by its owner and cannot arrive as private plugin semantics.

#### Consent role and natural-member boundary

ConsentRoleCatalogV1 is exactly AffirmativeHumanConsent in this revision. TargetConsentRequirementTemplateV1 binds one de1a target candidate and expands to finite unordered ConsentRequirementMemberRuleV1 values. #### Consent static applicability and horizon boundary

Applicability is pure exact target-leaf/protocol expansion with no current policy, time, latest, actor, responder, Mandate, Evidence outcome, issuance or adapter input. Member horizon is the finite nonempty compatible-coordinate intersection of the exact target Action horizon and every target-declared subject/effect/applicability upper bound. Missing, empty, unbounded, incompatible or overflowing bounds are unavailable; later G0, Binding, Mandate and source bounds only narrow.

Evidence may support Mandate provenance and set-wise assurance inputs for 11B-FE1. It cannot define a role, natural member, template, threshold, applicability, horizon, combination grammar, eligibility or independence. An affirmative Observation is acquisition evidence, not a template, slot, Mandate or authority.

#### Consent template persistence boundary

Persistence may store content-addressed role, template, member and horizon commitments only as records of owning Authority protocols. It cannot choose current templates, infer order, default k, construct roles, evaluate independence or repair missing joins. Revision changes create new member/slot commitments and stale old Mandates for the new target.

Authority owns the role catalog, natural-member grammar, templates and static expansion. No extension, policy, target candidate, requester, plugin, Recipe, provider, adapter or migration process may add roles, natural-member variants, templates, thresholds, applicability, horizons or combination predicates. New consent grammar is versioned core evolution with target-member, template, fulfillment, migration and proof closure.

The census is total over all 56 current CLI roots (43 visible, 13 hidden), every alias, JSON contract, MCP Tool, TUI flow, hook/event, public Skill/job/method/example, exactly ten active vNext Recipes, exactly two Bounded Continuation profiles, all fifteen v1 Recipe source dispositions, every persistent artifact, Resource, install/update target, archive/export/migration/rollback format and removal consumer. ### Supporting detail and retained evidence

The following material is retained from the prior canonical design. It is supporting detail under the synthesis above, not a competing definition; effective supersession and the authority order in Section 1 control.

#### Capability Census contract

The Capability Census is a normative design-closure ledger, not runtime state. It is complete only when every current public surface, machine contract, persistent byte source, shipped resource, and semantic user job appears exactly once in its own inventory dimension and joins to one canonical owner.

Each row records: stable census id; inventory dimension; current surface or artifact; user job; current implementation owner; current source or sources of truth; known overlap or defect; canonical vNext owner; exactly one disposition; migration strategy; proof requirement; removal consumers; unresolved dependencies; and closure status.

Allowed dispositions are exactly: core, Projection, Recipe, adapter, external pattern, migration-only, replace, or remove. Delivery stage is separate metadata and cannot narrow product scope.

Required dimensions are:

1. every CLI verb and alias;
2. every public and nested JSON contract, anonymous root, mixed-output path, and persistent schema identifier;
3. every MCP tool, JSON-RPC envelope, and tool-content wrapper;
4. every Rust and TypeScript TUI screen, mode, palette action, watch flow, and render contract;
5. every hook and event kind;
6. every shipped skill and installation target;
7. every shipped, custom, profile, pattern, and resolved Recipe format;
8. every persistent file, database row family, sidecar, object, index, cache, Workbench, and receipt;
9. every installed and update-managed resource;
10. every archive, export, backup, migration, quarantine, activation, rollback, and restore format; and
11. every semantic capability job in the full durable scope.

Closure requires exact generated source inventories, not prose confidence. Every retained adapter operation joins one semantic job to one Projection or frozen Action Spec. Every persistent source joins one migration row. Every material candidate Contract Component joins total typed Design or Decision provenance. The complete Decision Closure Manifest, Design Slot Manifest, finalization inputs, journeys, migration/removal matrices, and stage/proof set must cite the same closed census revision. Duplicate ownership, missing rows, unclassified outputs, mixed dispositions, removals without consumers, or stale generated inventories block Design Finalization and build approval.

Effective 1aac through 49af/2f53 freezes the public Packet/Operation/Result transport and six CLI roots; post-main head b46b replaces the superseded six-operation MCP candidate with exactly two read-only global Tools plus CLI governed execution. D0-D10 freeze the exact catalog schemas and identities. The current census still describes v1 jobs and observed contracts only as migration evidence and grants no legacy name runtime authority.

Planning closure adds two mechanical census gates. Every frozen ActionSpecV1 leaf declares exactly one scheduling classification, scheduling_participant or excluded, and the inventory proves every Planning-maintenance, authority, repair, and policy-publication leaf is excluded from self-ranking. Every current priority, deadline, lane, order, wave, route score, recommendation, planning prompt, and scheduler-like surface maps exactly once to Contract fact, Planning record, Projection, Recipe or external cadence, migration-only input, replacement, or removal; no legacy field becomes scheduling authority by spelling.

Remote-effect closure adds a separate mechanical origin gate. Every potentially side-effecting remote capability maps exactly once to one Candidate Effect Origin variant, an explicitly effect-free operation, a separately staged filesystem or Distribution protocol, or an external pattern. Each origin row has one source owner, exact immutable subject and cross-variant semantic-uniqueness key, allowed source Action leaves, forbidden fields, authority and credential basis, blocker applicability, migration, parity, proof, and reopen condition. EffectOriginV1 cannot freeze while a generic, missing, duplicate, dual-owned, or candidate-only runtime origin remains, and ActionSpecV1 cannot freeze before EffectOriginV1.

Coordination closure adds a mechanical advisory-model gate. Every current message, link, cursor, read, delivery, Presence, Session, claim, focus, scope, conflict, ownership, handoff, worktree, merge, cleanup and Inbox surface must map exactly once to Thread, Message, Acknowledgement, Focus, Scope, Conflict, Handoff, pure Presence or Inbox Projection, Execution-owned delivery, Evidence, governed Step execution, external staged Git pattern, migration-only input, replacement, or removal. The gate rejects mutable audience, implicit acknowledgement, address-derived permission, second conflict truth, Session-staleness resolution, queue or assignment state, Coordination-derived blocker or cleanup authority, remote-first send, fallback copy, legacy authority promotion, and any address or Message kind outside the closed union.

Distribution census closure is a typed join, not a one-manifest shortcut. Every one of the thirteen resource areas must map to exact candidate or release content, target policy, installed-claim treatment, pure planning treatment, local apply or read-only disposition, recovery and rollback treatment, migration rule, parity proof, and removal consumers. Those roles may not be conflated to satisfy coverage.

Distribution closure additionally requires a total CanonicalTargetId-to-AuthorityDomain join. Every installed or candidate target must prove complete physical alias closure, exactly one RepositoryDomain or InstallationDomain classification, one domain-qualified Plan and Transaction treatment, domain-local authority, idempotency, lock, phase, recovery and rollback disposition, and cross-domain correlation treatment. A requested path without proven target identity, an InstallationDomain target before genesis, a cross-domain Action or Packet row, or any Store role or publication authority outside the closed Repository Store or Installation Store union blocks census closure.

Certificate-value census rule after dec-canonical-installation-governance-23fd, dec-canonical-installation-governance-48a6, dec-canonical-installation-governance-f8c4 and dec-canonical-installation-governed-review-3ca1: a canonical internal value schema is not itself a persistent artifact, mutation, Action, Receipt, Result, Projection or adapter contract. The durable package-history obligation and total outcome coverage require a future canonical same-Installation-Store publication surface, while interaction provenance belongs only to separately acquired typed Evidence Observations and consent belongs only to Authority Mandates. The exact package aggregate, owner, Action, interaction-acquisition policy and every persistence or removal consumer remain separately classified so the value cannot silently manufacture record, interaction or authority semantics.

Every canonical owner inventory now adds an Authority Continuity coverage dimension: exact owner/source protocol, Context/branch, mechanically discovered CoverageObligation, exactly-one IncludedBy or ExplicitlyNonContinuity disposition, referenced DescriptorIds, proof and migration disposition. Census completeness cannot be derived from owner submissions. Final generation verifies no missing obligation, inferred exclusion, orphan descriptor, unclassified source or unsupported old client.

Every Authority Continuity class row now carries five closure-facet columns: CanonicalRecords, Graph, Replay, HistoricalSpend and UnresolvedEffect. The independent census records each exact obligation/disposition, owner law, contribution root or derived/non-applicable proof, semantic-cut side, bounds, migration and proof. Final totality joins these rows to Manifest classes and the envelope.

Every authority-changing mutation row now records exact TransitionGuardKind or explicit outside-kernel ceremony status, owning term schema, basis fields, classifier/downgrade/continuity owner, Action leaf, same-Store recheck and refusal/migration proof. No row may use generic transition, optional terms or an unversioned extension kind.

- Remote-first Codex send and fallback_local after ambiguity are remove. A crash between publication and delivery origination is one valid local-only Message.
- Worktree path intention is replace -> Scope Declaration; branch, base, head, target, destination, concern and commit context is replace -> Handoff; filesystem state and outcomes are replace -> Evidence.
- Governed merge or Contract-required cleanup is ordinary Step execution. Ungoverned Git worktree mechanics and physical cleanup are external staged patterns. Coordination never blocks cleanup.

Migration preserves exact flags, output, stderr, exit behavior, line order, timestamp ties, missing ids, cursors, hidden history, malformed records, actor strings, worktree bytes, receipts and fallback ambiguity as fixtures and sealed provenance. ##### Recovery-admission Operation adapter closure

`operation prepare` and `capability` expose the exact supported Action or admission CeremonySpec and its typed inputs without donating applicability or authority. `operation submit` accepts explicit `InitiateNew | RecoverReserved` for the four reserve Actions and explicit `Initiate | RecoverReserved | ResolveResult | Withdraw` for each of the eleven Ceremonies. `operation result` is pure and may advertise `RecoverReserved` only for the exact current `ReservedUnsealedV1` Attempt, `ResolveResult` only for the exact in-doubt Ceremony Attempt, or `Withdraw` only for the exact same-spec branch whose current Head has live dispatch `None`, classification `prepared | confirmed_not_applied`, no live Attempt/fence/seal/release, closed Runs and the exact fresh branch authority/currentness/capacity required by H3; it invokes none. The same typed modes, precondition refusals and seven outcomes round-trip through CLI/JSON, TUI and the one Skill. MCP remains exactly the two read-only Packet/catalog discovery Tools and performs no mode. Hooks and noun Action clients cannot invoke, resolve, withdraw, retry, poll, translate or alias any admission or recovery mode.

##### Resource coverage gate

Distribution coverage must enumerate all nine current resource-contract families plus TUI, MCP configuration, install state and binary update. Each member joins distinct candidate-or-release content, target-policy, installed-claim, pure-Plan, mutation or read-only, recovery and rollback roles; no monolithic Resource Manifest or physical record shape is implied. Every member has identity, version, content hash, provenance, ownership evidence, mutation policy and proof. A source or installed target appearing in two writable families, lacking an owner, drifting from its claim, changing under passive read, or lacking recovery disposition blocks approval.

Distribution authority-domain coverage gate: every one of the thirteen resource areas classifies each concrete target into exactly one RepositoryDomain or InstallationDomain after alias closure. Cross-domain families use separate Plan, Transaction, Result, recovery and rollback rows; no convenience surface creates cross-domain atomicity. The effective `decset-maestro-vnext-capability-complete-remaining-architecture-2f1119` closure and its merge heads close the Installation publication transaction and Result mechanics, downgrade, administration/successor viability, Epoch/high-water/recovery, Projection/Packet scope, staged effects, target identity/custody, binary replacement and writer admission. These are candidate Contract obligations, not implemented behavior; any row lacking its exact owner, typed carrier or proof still blocks build approval rather than reopening a product-level fork.

Hooks, skills and Recipes may invoke protected inspection or verification of exact core-versioned continuity material, but they cannot contribute owner census rows, register classes, supply executable descriptor logic, infer exclusions, choose current manifest, skip unknowns, create proposal applicability state or turn advisor output into continuity authority.

Hooks, skills and Recipes may request supported protected closure inspection or verification but cannot enumerate authoritative facets, choose NotApplicable, interpret graph edges, replay deltas, allocate tokens, select current closure, resolve effects or bypass old-client refusal.

Hooks, skills and Recipes may request/transport a supported guard Projection but cannot choose kind, build terms, supply witnesses, interpret protected refusal, cache Satisfied, execute unknown variants or authorize actual genesis.

## 8. Agent UX: one Skill, seven jobs and bootstrap

There is exactly one discoverable public Skill named `maestro`. It progressively discloses seven internal jobs: Setup, Research, Design, Review, Execute, Recover and Adapt. Its active Agent-visible instruction tree is exactly 31 Resources: one root, seven jobs, seventeen direct method roots, five TDD children and one optional Research examples Resource. DDD is a Design method; TDD is Execute-only. Wayfinding is a Recipe. Extension Law is a hard boundary. No separately discoverable `maestro-setup`, `maestro-research`, `maestro-design`, `maestro-work`, `maestro-audit`, `maestro-witness`, `ask-maestro` or `maestro-card` survives, and no runtime alias translates them.

The public repository bootstrap is `.maestro/MAESTRO.md`, sourced from `embedded/bootstrap/MAESTRO.md`. Root `AGENTS.md` owns one exact managed pointer to it. The bootstrap is thin: canonical-state and Projection boundary, public discovery names, CLI-first governed Operation execution, no-guess rule and fail-closed missing/incompatible behavior. Identity hashes live in manifests and Receipts, not Agent-facing Markdown; the Skill does not repeat the pointer instruction.

The one active Skill materialization is `~/.maestro/skills/maestro`. `~/.agents/skills/maestro` is the universal Codex/compatible-CLI activation and `~/.claude/skills/maestro` the Claude activation. They may be trusted Receipt-bound alias roots to the same identity. Arbitrary, escaping, substituted or ambiguous links fail closed. `~/.codex/skills` is never created.

After a compatible active Store exists, Agent UX is discovery-when-needed, Packet-first and CLI-first. When the Agent lacks exact current Recipe/profile identities, it requests `DiscoverSelectionContextV1`, receives all 30 options, copies one complete option into `RecipeSelectionRequestV1` and submits `ProjectV1`; Projection returns one bounded Packet with its required Recipe binding or a typed refusal. The Agent uses `maestro_cli_search` only to discover the running binary catalog when needed, executes the exact shell-visible CLI Operation, then reads the Result and starts again from fresh reads. First-use Setup uses the distinct `BootstrapNoRecipeV1` read and exact owner facts before it may invoke the sole `no_store` Installation genesis Ceremony; Repository and Installation recovery admission are `pre_store` only. These paths never fabricate a Packet or infer Setup from Store absence; after admission they reobserve canonical state before continuing. The Agent never guesses command names, selection identities, private state or retries.

The root Skill derives one fresh `JobRouteV1` only after the exact Packet, except for the exact bootstrap-fact Setup branch. Recovery dominates explicit read-only Research/Review intent; ordinary Packet reasons map totally to one job or a refusal. JobRoute loads one job, zero methods and zero Recipes. A later shared Capability resolver accepts the job-only plan or exactly one typed direct-method request and its minimal admitted TDD-child, Research-example or Review-auxiliary closure. Multiple direct roots are Ambiguous. Agent guidance is rendered separately from Projection-owned next action. Every Result/read/method output invalidates the route; no job cursor or telemetry event resumes it.

When Review is selected, the root Skill uses the shared post-route Capability resolver. Inspect has no primary; Audit, AdversarialReview, QAReplay and CloseReview each have one fixed primary. Audit may add an exact typed subset of ArchitectureReview, GenerateAndFilter and Verification; CloseReview may add Verification; the other modes admit no auxiliary. Exactly thirteen of forty mode/subset shapes admit. Auxiliaries remain inside one primary invocation and produce no independent result. `ReviewRepairRecheck` is caller-local convenience only: each result returns control, and the next fresh Packet may choose any job or refusal. Method output is visibly noncanonical until a separately advertised authorized Evidence Action succeeds. A required independent CloseReview cannot be satisfied by the repairer's Principal, Session or model/tool lineage.

TDD loads no child by default and may load only the typed subset of TestDesign, InterfaceDesign, external-boundary Mocking, current-GREEN Refactoring and DeepModules required by the current Execute invocation. Research examples are default-unloaded and reachable only from Research through an exact typed example need. Each supported host admits the Skill only after its Release-bound `ContextBudgetProfileV1` proves every reachable closure; excess refuses rather than truncating or widening limits.

After any job is selected, the root Skill applies the shared Job-to-Recipe admission to the already sealed application. It loads no Recipe for core-only, exactly the admitted selected component Resources for one/two-component applications, or no Recipe on refusal. It never copies the matrix into prose, silently drops a component or treats the edge as permission. Recipe return labels stay visibly Recipe-scoped and cannot replace the separate JobRoute Reason display.

Setup preserves the same ordering. Before an active Store and Packet it uses `BootstrapNoRecipeV1`, validates one exact `BootstrapRouteFactViewV1` and loads zero Recipe Resources. After a Packet, Projection has already selected the RecipeApplication; JobRoute may select Setup; Capability may then load only the already selected `setup` and optional Bounded Continuation Resources. The one Setup Recipe exposes exactly Install, Adopt, Migrate, Update, Repair, Rollback and Uninstall as restrictive procedure modes. The root Skill calls the shared resolver with one coherent locality view and an explicit `Require(mode) | AcceptUniqueEligible` request, then renders its ephemeral result separately from the Projection-owned next action. Omission is invalid; Operation compatibility validates after facts and request and never chooses a mode. Possible or unresolved effects block ordinary Setup and route Recover. No Skill prose or host adapter may copy or default the resolver.

After one successful complete route/load finalization, the root Skill may form one ephemeral `SkillActivationCandidateV1` from already returned commitments and Resource identities. That act and all routing/loading remain pure. The route is then discarded. If a fresh Packet separately advertises and authorizes existing Action 30, the root may submit it directly without deriving another JobRoute or loading Execute; the Action publishes existing Observation kind 12 or refuses. Publication is optional, adds zero Resource reads and never changes guidance. `Ambiguous`, `Blocked`, `Refused` and pre-Store candidates that cannot be causally matched to a same-Release active Store publish nothing. Resume always ignores candidate and Observation history.

## 9. Public Integration surfaces

All executable adapters share one semantic Packet/Operation/Result model where that transport applies and add no private lifecycle, authority, retry, Store or next-action behavior. CLI is the complete executable public surface. The two MCP Tools are the deliberate read-only exception: they return packet-read discovery/bootstrap/Projection facts or structured capability-catalog facts and are not OperationSpec, OperationRequest or OperationResult variants. JSON is additive, versioned and parseable. TUI is a hermetic renderer over the same contracts. Hooks append normalized Observations/events and tolerate partial delivery without becoming authority. Shell integration exposes only declared conveniences.

MCP is global User-Agent installation only and read-only. Exactly two Tools exist per admitted host: `maestro_packet` and `maestro_cli_search`. `maestro_packet` accepts exactly `BootstrapNoRecipeV1 | DiscoverSelectionContextV1 | ProjectV1(RecipeSelectionRequestV1)` and returns exactly `Packet | SelectionContext | NoActiveStore | Unavailable | Stale | Incompatible`; only Packet contains the required Recipe binding. `maestro_cli_search` queries the structured capability catalog of the running Installation-bound binary. It does not read `cli.md`, help prose or Skill text. Projects/worktrees install no MCP server, descriptor set or private Tool version.

Agents execute governed Action or Ceremony Operations through the exact shell-visible Maestro CLI. There is no generic tool-call gateway, dynamic Tool injection, individual lifecycle MCP family, Agent-facing `cli.md` or v1 spelling translation. Binary, Skill, catalog, MCP descriptor and TUI Release skew fails closed and recommends explicit repair/reconnect.

Local withdrawal uses that unchanged Operation envelope. CLI human/JSON, TUI, shell and the one Skill submit the same exact Action or Ceremony request and render the committed Result as `withdrawn locally; no provider cancellation performed`. The two MCP Tools remain read-only and unchanged. No Packet, MCP, JobRoute, JobGuidance, Recipe, Setup, SkillActivation or OperationResult field is added; any adapter that says or implies provider cancellation, chooses a basis, writes a Head, retries or hides a refusal violates parity and fails closed.

`JobGuidanceEnvelopeV1` is the additive Integration view for CLI guidance JSON, TUI and the one Skill. It contains an exact current 7138 Packet or exact bootstrap fact view beside one ephemeral JobRoute. Human text renders next action and Agent guidance as separate labels. Raw Packet JSON stays available with the required Recipe binding and no route companion. `maestro_packet` returns no route field, no third MCP Tool exists, and no adapter owns a private reason map or current job.

Capability method resolution is a sibling Integration view, not a Packet extension. CLI JSON, TUI and the Skill render the same `CapabilityMethodIntentV1`, `CapabilityMethodResolutionV1`, exact load plan, `ReviewModeResolutionV1`, `ReviewMethodInvocationV1` and mode payload. No adapter carries a private method map or caller-supplied plan. Produced, Refused, conclusive Failed and no-envelope transport/crash outcomes remain distinct. Integration never translates them into Assessment, Gate satisfaction, approval, retry or next action; the next executable instruction still comes only from a fresh Projection.

Job-to-Recipe admission and Recipe-return trace are internal additive Integration views. They add no AgentPacket, MCP, JobGuidance or OperationResult field. Identical Release/application/route/relation inputs produce identical NoRecipe/Admitted/Refused and load closure across supported hosts, CLI JSON and TUI. Return reasons render in their Orchestration namespace only; no adapter aliases them to a 5d72 route reason or infers a job.

Setup-mode rendering is another sibling pure Integration view over the locked `SetupModeResolutionV1`; it adds no AgentPacket, MCP, JobGuidance, OperationResult, RecipeManifest, RecipeApplication, JobRoute or SkillActivation field. CLI human/JSON, TUI, shell/bootstrap, the one Skill and supported hosts call one Release-bound resolver and must render the same selected mode or typed refusal. In `active_store`, six modes validate only the matching Distribution Plan intent and Adopt validates only the two custody-transition Actions. In `no_store`, only `InstallationContextGenesis` may validate fact-eligible Install, Adopt or Migrate as a prerequisite. In `pre_store`, only the two cutover Ceremonies validate Migrate; the other eight pre-store Ceremonies validate no Setup mode. Every Result or relevant currentness change discards the view and requires recomputation.

Skill-activation publication adds no public transport variant. Candidate formation is internal to the one root Skill; CLI human/JSON and TUI may inspect the resulting immutable Observation through existing Evidence reads, while the governed publication itself uses the exact CLI Operation path. Hooks do not auto-publish. `maestro_packet` and `maestro_cli_search` remain exactly the current 7138 read-only Tools with no activation companion. Cross-host parity compares payload semantics; distinct host/session provenance correctly yields distinct Observation identities.

## 11. Installation and Repository domain topology

One `InstallationDomain` exists per externally enforceable protected User-Agent realm, normally one OS-user realm. It owns the canonical Skill materialization, trusted activation links, and the exact admitted-host/config-root MCP descriptor, server and configuration registrations; every such registration exposes the same closed two-Tool catalog, `maestro_packet` and `maestro_cli_search`, rather than implying two physical descriptor files. It also owns Installation Receipt/claims, currentness, recovery and snapshot catalog. A Maestro-owned binary and hermetic TUI target joins that domain only when alias, manager, security-realm, authority, recovery and rollback closure prove the same InstallationId and a nonoverlapping target namespace; a system/root/package-manager target remains an exact external manager input or a separately proved InstallationDomain. Each checkout/worktree is one separate `RepositoryDomain` owning its Store, `.maestro/MAESTRO.md`, the exact root `AGENTS.md` managed block and declared Adapt Resources. No Plan, transaction, Receipt, Result, snapshot, rollback or atomicity claim spans domains.

Custody is closed. `MaestroOwnedTarget` may be replaced by a freshly authorized install/sync/update/migrate/restore Operation despite byte drift only when a current same-domain claim proves whole-target custody. `SharedManagedBlock` permits replacement only inside the exact block and preserves every outside byte. Unmanaged, foreign, ambiguous or unsafe targets never overwrite and fail closed. Receipt alone proves no custody. Every mutation uses visible diff, exact effect-boundary preimage, coherent backup, alias/stale fences and recovery.

Each exact domain/realm exposes at most two ordinary user-selectable prior successful full snapshots; current state is excluded. Capture coherent current state before activation and prune only after committed activation. Rollback restores one exact snapshot without merge and snapshots the state it replaces. Retention holds for unfinished Intents, recovery, sealed migration rollback, prior binaries/protocol compatibility, legal/export or replay obligations are separate protected roots and never count as selectable snapshots. Failed garbage collection creates inaccessible debt, not a third selectable snapshot or lost hold.

Global host mutation may be physically partial across files/processes; semantic currentness commits only after full same-domain verification. Crash or ambiguity returns recovery-required/in-doubt. A later RepositoryDomain failure does not roll back a successful global Result.

The one-Skill/two-MCP cutover has no publish-then-cleanup state. After writer freeze and byte-total inventory, the exact pre-cutover closure is protected, the new closure is staged, all targets are custody-classified, and bounded effects physically install the new targets and deactivate every authorized legacy discovery target. The entire declared-root closure, recovery material and active-consumer refusal are reobserved before success. Active-store success is one atomic Store join; initial migration uses `InstallationV1Cutover` with the complete inactive Store behind its protected expected-old carrier. During any crossed-but-unpublished interval the realm is unavailable and routes Recover. Unmanaged collisions remain untouched and block. Host reconnect is post-commit live compatibility, so a stale process refuses without invalidating the installed-state commit.

## 12. Persistence, migration, quarantine and removal

Persistence provides one mutable Store authority per exact domain, immutable objects/history, expected-old CAS publication, reachability, tombstones, retention, sealed export, inactive restore and explicit recovery. Domain policy remains with owning contexts. Search indexes and Projections are rebuildable and non-canonical.

vNext is a clean runtime break with offline byte-total migration and rollback.
