Resolved: Policy Binding Replacement requires an unchanged structural Root and a behavior-bearing Policy change; any structural Root, Floor, grammar, evaluator-compatibility, or semantic-owner-compatibility change is Structural Root/Floor Replacement and may atomically carry a Policy change.
- Governance transition previously risked admitting Epoch, Trust Root, Store Generation, Realm, Locator, relocation, or recovery changes through the same union. Resolved: the governance-content union requires those protected fields to remain exact; other changes use their own later ceremony and deny here.
- Governance classification previously appeared indivisible from transition formulas. Base formulas, pure comparison, Certificate value, durable history, coverage, interaction acquisition, Publication Fact, its authority subject and verifier closure remain independent locked components. The separately locked publication transaction, exact Observation taxonomy and downgrade consent preserve every base term; no value, Fact, closure, old Grant or bridge can authorize or weaken the transition.

- Comparison Certificate previously implied durable storage. Resolved: in dec-canonical-installation-governance-23fd, Certificate means one canonical content-addressed aggregate value schema only. Persistence owns no record or publication until a later Decision.
- Applicability previously collapsed semantic correctness, live subject identity, consent eligibility, and current authority. Resolved: semantic_match, subject_match, outcome_eligible, and live_authorized are four distinct derived Conditions. None is a stored current, stale, fresh, valid, usable, approved, authorized, or executable field.
- Comparison identity previously risked importing revocation, Grant consumption, time, witness availability, Session, Mandate, Receipt, or storage metadata. Resolved: those facts remain outside the static Certificate identity and are freshly evaluated only by later authority-bearing actions; a future time-sensitive Comparison Protocol must put its deterministic time boundary inside the semantic key explicitly.
- Non-Direction comparison outcomes previously implied either no canonical value or automatic audit retention. Resolved: every valid bounded subject may have a canonical value representation, while malformed or secret-bearing staging input does not; dec-canonical-installation-governance-f8c4 makes every constructible outcome eligible for the separately authorized 48a6 durable-history boundary without granting publication authority or raw-diagnostic retention.
- Governed-review package history previously implied either consumer-bound materialization or standalone durable history. Resolved by dec-canonical-installation-governance-48a6: every successful separately authorized package materialization leaves canonical durable history even with no later consumer. dec-canonical-installation-governance-f8c4 now resolves coverage as every 23fd-constructible outcome while preserving Direction-only consent eligibility.

- Governance review previously conflated a content-addressed Certificate package, a durable package-publication fact, carrier-attested presentation, and rejection or abandonment. Resolved by the governed-review chain and the final Observation/catalog freezes: package history proves publication only; consequential presentation and explicit response acquisition are exact Evidence Observations; consent remains an Authority Mandate; silence has no inferred meaning; behavior-bearing disposition remains its separately owned typed Action consequence.
- Durable history previously risked meaning immortal full payload retention. Resolved: durable means canonical under the locked retention, legal-hold, security-erasure and tombstone law. The obligation survives absence of a later consumer; 9543 fixes logical minimization, while Persistence's retention/GC protocol and protected disclosure law govern physical objects, access and erasure.

- Publication coverage previously risked reusing outcome_eligible. Resolved by dec-canonical-installation-governance-f8c4: coverage is every 23fd-constructible outcome, while outcome_eligible remains Direction-only and solely concerns the later downgrade-consent overlay.
- Invalid previously risked mixing rejected outer input with a canonical inner result. Resolved: malformed, ambiguous, unbounded or secret-bearing outer Staging Input without K_subject is not a Certificate and has no coverage. Covered Invalid is only a bounded typed 427c result after canonical subject construction.
- All-outcome coverage previously risked implying raw-diagnostic retention. Resolved: coverage grants no permission to persist raw offending bytes, candidate-controlled text, paths, topology, live authority identities, clauses, counterexamples, secrets or low-entropy secret hashes. The 9543 verifier closure supplies a fixed safe machine-checkable representation for every outcome; if that becomes impossible, publication remains non-executable and 23fd, 427c or f8c4 reopens rather than silently dropping coverage.

- Human Review Occurrence previously risked becoming a third owner over Evidence provenance and Authority consent. Resolved by dec-canonical-installation-governed-review-3ca1: no standalone occurrence aggregate, Store, head, lifecycle or selector exists. When acquired, presentation and explicit non-authoritative response are separate typed Evidence Observations; Authority Mandates remain the sole consent and quorum facts; any behavior-bearing disposition requires its own later owner and Decision.
- Absence of an interaction record previously risked proving that no interaction happened. Resolved: a pre-commit crash leaves interaction canonically unproven, silence infers nothing, and absence from complete retained history means only that neither a canonical Observation nor governed tombstone establishes the fact.

- Governed-review interaction acquisition previously left consequential audit optional or adapter-selected. Resolved by dec-canonical-governed-review-interaction-99e0: core capability classifies inspect-only versus consequential before rendering; inspect-only remains pure and cannot upgrade in place; consequential render or handoff precedes presentation commit, response acceptance follows that commit, response commit precedes any later Mandate or disposition reference, and Evidence failure blocks only the consequential path.

- Governed-review package history previously conflated a pure Certificate value, a canonical publication fact, generic request audit and repeated human interaction. Resolved: one Authority-owned Publication Fact binds one exact K_subject plus CertificateId semantic subject; requests, Receipts, Results, Mandates, dispositions and Evidence acquisitions remain separate; the locked final-publication transaction supplies runtime authority, idempotency, high-water and atomic visibility without adding a second owner.

- Governed-review package publication previously risked treating a third subject family as a third Authority owner, duplicating live AuthorityContext or derived Certificate and Fact fields inside the subject, or using a comparison bridge to widen old Grants. Resolved by dec-canonical-governed-package-publication-4d1b: there remains one Authority owner and evaluator; the new closed family carries only PublicationSubjectV1; CertificateId and Fact identity are freshly derived or totally verified; the current Head and Root select the exact owner requirement; old Grants, broad scopes, aliases, wildcards and bridges grant no coverage.

Post-9543 ambiguity resolution: package payload no longer means a second copied archive or an open set of bytes selected by Persistence. VerifierClosureV1 is exactly the Certificate plus the transitive closure of the one CertificateId-committed proof-object manifest. Minimal means closed protocol-derived role necessity, not discretionary omission. Offline verification reconstructs the bundled historical subject and proof result but never establishes fresh subject_match, currentness, authorization, actual publication or destination activation. A later tombstone may make closure unavailable; remaining hashes may not be presented as a smaller verifier-complete package.

- Convergent publication previously meant either same-key replay or a different-key request that could succeed merely because the Fact existed. Resolved by dbaa: same-key replay alone is free; every different key is a fresh Action Request that independently re-passes current authority and admission at its own serialization snapshot. An existing Fact is non-bearer and cannot lend consumed authority.
- Non-disclosing publication previously implied absolute existence confidentiality across timing, Store access, audit and budget state. Resolved at this boundary: the ordinary successful semantic Result is branch-neutral and exposes no created-versus-preexisting distinction. Protected diagnostics, audit access, timing/resource side channels and failure-response policy remain separate forks; no stronger confidentiality claim is inferred.

- Publication convergence previously looked like either a pure read or a second publication attempt. Resolved by 655d: every successful different key is one Authority-owned Publication Establishment Action with the same common request-scoped Action floor; only the internal first branch publishes the sole Fact and logical closure relation.
- Authority consumption previously risked meaning every available Mandate or every matching Grant path. Resolved: consume only the exact Mandates required by the selected requirement and the applicable bounded units in one complete canonical authorizing witness set. Unused alternatives remain untouched. Cc17 locks canonical Coverage and Debit normalization, anti-steering, coherent Selection Basis and the fail-closed absence boundary; 73be locks the pure RankW comparator; ef04 locks the pure attribution join. Concrete key members, provenance and reissuance rules, requirement floors, Mandate assurance, Consumption Cell origin and partition semantics and context carriers remain separate current-governance dependencies.
- Budget previously conflated mutation authority, admission, compute, staging, semantic Fact count, logical reachability and physical bytes. Resolved by split: 655d locks only exact Action-authority consumption and semantic nonconsumption for unsuccessful paths. Quota and resource accounting topology remains a later fork after the attribution chain closes.

- Authorizing witness selection previously lacked a rule for multiple live Grant paths, quorum combinations or alternative Mandates. Resolved through cc17, 73be and ef04 at the current parametric floor: Authority alone canonicalizes exact Coverage and Debit closures, preserves distinct scarce alternatives, performs the pure attribution join and RankW comparison, and commits the complete current Selection Basis. One unique semantic minimum may select only after the concrete key, provenance and carrier successors close; otherwise evaluation fails closed. Requesters, adapters, candidate governance and raw identity or storage order never select.

- Authorizing witness allocation previously conflated five independently dangerous shortcuts: a generic metadata matcher, weighted cost, record-specific keys, support multiplicity and Mandate double weighting. Resolved at the pure algebra boundary by dec-canonical-authority-witness-allocation-73be and the pure attribution boundary by ef04: ranking consumes only cc17-normalized candidates, counts each exact DebitMap atom once, treats Mandates only as debit, observes only the worst complete Grant ancestry and Requirement Floor class after equal debit, and requires one unique minimum. Concrete semantic-key vocabulary, provenance, cell and Mandate rules, and carriers remain explicit later forks; no matcher, raw identity, contributor count or physical order fills the gap.

- Allocation semantic key previously risked meaning an attribution use-site, a record identity, a provenance digest, a class label or a direct record priority. Resolved at the A0 boundary: the four closed Allocation Attribution Roles are use-sites only; the finite core Allocation Semantic Key universe is separately frozen and record-independent; provenance is a separate commitment; class is the result of one exact manifest lookup.
- Terminal Grant role previously risked classifying only the leaf. Resolved: Grant Ancestry Support applies independently to every Grant in the complete terminal-contributor ancestry. Terminality belongs to the cc17 candidate, not immutable Grant key identity.
- Shared allocation class previously risked one cross-Store policy object. Resolved: one class universe is shared across all four attribution roles only inside one exact Authority Context. Repository and Installation authority, objects and transactions never cross.
- Key equality previously risked deduplicating authority. Resolved: it means class equality only and never merges Debit atoms, Mandates, Consumption Cells, Grant paths, lineage, provenance, quorum contributors or independence.
- Same key previously risked confusing an Allocation Semantic Key with an Action idempotency key. Resolved: replay language always says same Action idempotency key; semantic-key equality has no replay authority.

##### Consumption Cell conservation-identity ambiguity resolution

- Consumption Cell previously risked meaning a Grant record, mutable counter row, arbitrary quantity pool, semantic class bucket or composite merge identity. Resolved at the 18b0 A0 boundary: its internal conservation identity is one immutable context-qualified root accepted only through a separately frozen origin protocol; this ruling creates and activates none.
- Genuinely new capacity previously risked being proven by a successful issuance request, nonce, idempotency key, candidate Grant, administrator assertion or Persistence row. Resolved conditionally by b912: none proves backing, and the pure identity/assertion normal form yields no candidate until a concrete kind law proves pre-existing backing, natural cardinality, aliases and disjointness. Concrete kinds, backing schemas and root establishment remain separate Authority forks.
- Split, merge, delegation, reissue and correction previously risked minting or collapsing roots. Resolved only at the topology-normalization floor: every non-origin transformation may preserve or narrow its exact input root closure and may never add, replace, coalesce, reinterpret or replenish roots. Their quantitative state machines remain later.
- RootSetDigest previously risked being treated as a conservation or debit commitment. Resolved: it proves only finite canonical source closure. F100 closes fixed one-use quantity; active partition or seal revisions, unique debit obligations, remaining capacity and consumption publication require the later full DebitMap commitment.
- One root previously risked hiding arbitrary aggregate quantity from 73be. Resolved as an explicit blocker: F100 now proves the fixed one-use debit quantum, so 73be needs no quantity supersession; it remains non-executable until origin, partitions, provenance, carriers, administration viability, high-water and the final transaction close.
- Composite merge previously risked creating another spendable cell. Resolved at this boundary: any future composite is a recursively flattened non-spendable view with no identity, capacity, authority, selector, Store, head or replay namespace.
- Root equality or inequality previously risked deciding quorum independence. Resolved: both are preserved evidence only. The exact cc17 pinned independence predicate alone decides independence.
- Same-realm recovery previously risked carrying one active root across Authority Contexts. Resolved fail-closed: source root history may be retained under locked continuity, but active successor mapping is a later Decision; new realm and v1 migration activate no root, including no zero-capacity placeholder.

##### Authority-use debit quantum ambiguity resolution

- Selected root debit previously said zero or one. Resolved by f100: every applicable selected bounded root contributes exactly one Authority-use debit on a successfully committed fresh Action. Zero means no such bounded root or no successful Action; a zero-valued selected atom is invalid.
- One Action leaf previously risked meaning one target or one physical effect. Resolved: closed leaves may be compound and Installation Distribution subjects may contain target sets. Every future leaf freezes semantic subject cardinality and proves no legitimate same-root q greater than one, or f100 and 73be must be superseded.
- Resource accounting previously risked becoming a separate Authority Context. Resolved: owner-specific accounting dimensions stay in the same domain and Action protocol, derive from canonical subject and target or effect closure, are conjunctive and pre-effect, and can only constrain. They never grant authority or select a witness.
- Physical quantity previously risked multiplying Consumption Cell use automatically. Resolved: bytes, compute, provider charges, staging, storage, attempts and duration do not change the fixed root-use quantum. Target or effect cardinality may remain an exact Authority constraint and accounting input without becoming same-root debit quantity.
- RankW previously risked being described as a complete scarcity optimizer. Resolved: under f100 it exactly counts current Action-use debit atoms while intentionally ignoring remaining capacity. Origin and administration viability must prevent grinding and deadlock.
- A locally rootless terminal Grant previously risked hiding a bounded ancestor or being inferred from missing migration data. Resolved by 1c5a: NoLocalBoundedRoot contributes nothing locally but cannot erase ancestry; only a complete valid path with an empty Ancestry Root Closure is EffectivelyUnbounded, and legacy missing, zero or unlimited fields activate no local constraint or Grant.

##### Prospective capacity-origin normal-form ambiguity resolution

- Origin identity previously risked including the backing assertion or exact validator revision. Resolved by b912: the full typed Origin Identity Key is Context plus stable Identity Family plus Backing Equivalence Domain plus Canonical Natural Subject; the kind-defined Backing Assertion and validator revision are separately committed.
- Generic natural backing previously risked being treated as already proven. Resolved conditionally: b912 proves only a normal form. No candidate exists until a later closed kind catalog proves authoritative source identity, natural cardinality, aliases, disjoint backing, unit, initial maximum and separability.
- Current governance declaration, issuance success, Grant, request, Receipt, Result, Observation or first writer previously risked creating its own backing. Resolved: backing must pre-exist in the exact current Selection Basis and recognition cannot be the same semantic step as backing creation.

- A multi-claim carrier previously risked implying several roots or one batch Action. Resolved: claims normalize only as inactive proposals after pairwise disjoint-backing proof; a joint pool stays one proposal and no establishment Action is created.

- "Origin Kind Catalog" previously risked meaning that b912 or 78fb had admitted a usable catalog. Resolved: 78fb freezes only an admission and exclusion frame. The current catalog is incomplete, validate_one is unavailable and every bounded-authority path remains blocked.
- "Genesis Attestation" previously risked being promoted from activation evidence to conservation backing. - Local Unbounded previously risked describing an empty local contribution as an effectively unbounded Grant. Resolved by 1c5a: the local closed type is NoLocalBoundedRoot or BoundedBy. EffectivelyUnbounded and EffectivelyBounded are derived only after complete valid ancestry composition and grant no permission by themselves.

- BootstrapControl previously risked becoming an executable umbrella. Resolved: it is only a closed future semantic family and supplies no Action leaf, Mandate, transition, recovery or runtime availability at this boundary.

##### Authority epoch-continuity provenance ambiguity resolution

- Planned turnover and post-loss recovery previously risked collapsing into one local Mandate ceremony. Resolved by 9823: they are distinct non-interchangeable provenance classes with distinct authorization sources; post-loss recovery never consumes stale local authority.
- Repeated genesis previously risked becoming the recovery escape hatch. Resolved: ContextGenesis remains the sole already-authorized genesis provenance and gains no repeated-genesis semantics.

Resolved as a decomposition boundary only: candidate-root cardinality, trusted time, first-human enrollment, Mandate causality and slots, closed high-water, planned activation, class-total disposition, recovery and external crash semantics remain separate forks.
- Host-only first-human enrollment, inert-candidate descendant reissue, complete old-authority disposition and external high-water atomicity previously appeared solvable by wording. Resolved as explicit blockers: none is implementation detail and none may become executable without its own reviewed Decision.

- Future-root preparation previously risked creating an actual reserved Epoch or G0. Resolved by e7ad for post-ContextGenesis successors: one immutable proposal value counts as zero Epochs, zero structural G0s and zero live G0s.
- A generic expected-current basis previously collapsed planned turnover with post-loss recovery. Resolved: proposal identity carries one provenance-specific basis reference; planned turnover uses the exact live-current basis, while recovery uses the later last-trusted historical plus external-continuity basis and never stale local authority.
- Stable Realm versus Context snapshot wording previously risked a third identity or silent b72b supersession. Resolved: proposals use existing RepositoryInstallationId or InstallationId branch identity and do not redefine AuthorityContextV1.
- Semantic duplicate convergence previously risked collapsing Action authorization and consumption. Resolved: convergence is value-only; every future different-key mutation retains independent authority, witness, consumption, Receipt, Result and idempotency semantics.
- Multiple proposals previously risked a hidden selector. Resolved: finite inert values have no pending Head, rank, vote, preparation winner or lifecycle. Exact target choice is distinct from Authority witness selection.
- ContextGenesis candidate staging previously risked being overwritten. Resolved: 5cd5 and effective c5ab remain unchanged; initial inactive Store, Epoch-zero, Trust, Binding and genesis-Grant material use their existing ceremony only.
- Basis mismatch is derived inapplicability, not explicit abandonment. Authorized disqualification, admission, quota, retention, erasure and garbage collection remain independent forks.

- G0 live, suspended, resumed, and expired previously risked becoming a second stored Authority lifecycle. Resolved by 9371: each G0 has one immutable finite half-open validity interval, while Premature, Live, ExpiryCertain, and TimeUnavailable are protected derived Conditions for one exact Authority Selection Basis. H_time is an already accepted monotonic proven lower bound, not a lifecycle head or generic recovery authority. A proof that classifies ExpiryCertain denies prospective authority, but irreversible expiry follows only when accepted H_time is at or beyond not_after. Decision 626e locks immutable policy-reference and pure exact-attempt validation semantics without proof admission; 5976 locks the pure exhaustive possible-honest-world aggregation algebra; 65bf locks catalog-relative Source Unit assurance; 1675 locks acquisition observation closure; and 70c6 locks Source Epoch and Sequence Candidate Semantics. Carrier-specific Linearization Time Fence Capability is the immediate child, while H_time mutation and carrier remain in Authority Continuity Closure.

##### Trusted-time policy and pure-validation ambiguity resolution

- “Active policy” previously risked a second mutable Authority Head. Resolved by 626e: the policy binding is an immutable value resolved by exact already-authoritative branch material inside one Selection Basis; currentness, rotation, and carrier remain later Authority continuity mechanics.
- “Validated proof” previously risked admission, persistence, or bearer reuse. Resolved: the pure validator returns only an ephemeral attempt-local ValidatedTimeCandidate and writes no proof, Result, Receipt, idempotency, replay, audit, source Head, or H_time state.
- “Immediately before commit” previously overclaimed exact visibility coverage. Resolved: a later carrier-specific Linearization Time Fence must validate at or conservatively cover the exact Store commit, locator CAS, protected snapshot, or local Intent/reservation point; missing capability is Unavailable and no local proof covers a remote crossing.
- A denied, pure-query, inspection, or audit path cannot donate trusted-time input. Any later floor advance requires a fresh authorized attempt, while successful prospective mutation remains non-executable until later continuity law makes required floor advancement durable no later than visibility.
- Composite source closure is now a required closed declarative profile, not response-order policy. Decisions 5976, 65bf, 1675 and 70c6 lock source-role, quorum, fault, interval, assurance, acquisition and sequence-candidate closure; Carrier-specific Linearization Time Fence Capability is the immediate successor and cannot be guessed by adapters.

##### Trusted-time aggregation and source-admission ambiguity resolution

- A Trusted Time Aggregation Profile does not prove that named sources are independent. It consumes an already validated atomic-unit correlation and role closure; source admission, correlation Evidence, and role assurance are the immediate separate fork.
- Known-fault budget consumption is not inferred from a far interval, missing input, malformed bytes, an adapter label, or an empty world intersection. Only authenticated canonically attributable fault Evidence bound to the exact unit, policy, request, attempt, challenge, reference point, and validator may place a unit in E.
- Scalar N, F, and K do not replace semantic role adequacy. Every still-allowed fault placement must satisfy the frozen AdequateSourceRoleClosure before interval overlap is considered.
- Aggregation returns one interval plus a protected complete commitment, not a chosen honest set, faulty set, world, clique, source rank, epoch, sequence, or floor-acceptance candidate. Source epoch and sequence candidate semantics are now separately locked by 70c6 without adding floor acceptance.

##### Source-unit assurance ambiguity resolution

- Source independence previously risked being inferred from provider, key, path, pairwise labels, or absence of observed correlation. Resolved by 65bf: authenticated group-provenance hyperedges plus complete catalog-relative coverage are mandatory; absence of an edge proves nothing.
- A closed failure-domain catalog previously risked being described as real-world independence proof. Resolved: it is an explicit conditional assurance model and TCB premise. Every source-specific issuer, validator, trust, administration, rollback, host, transport, origin, and control dependency is graph-classified; any common core or host protector is explicitly global-TCB or a universal cause.
- Unknown correlation previously allowed adapter-selected collapse or refusal. Resolved deterministically: a known finite universe gains a may-share hyperedge over every plausible member, including the universal source set; unknown universe, catalog, authenticated coverage, dependency classification, or bounds makes the whole closure Unavailable.
- Assurance freshness previously risked circular dependence on the time being constructed. Resolved: bootstrap and recovery applicability require external, core- or host-protected monotonic non-time assurance/revocation revision plus branch binding and anti-replay. Time expiry alone never establishes applicability.
- Stable source lineage previously risked carrying accepted floors through revision, merge, split, credential, issuer, validator, operator, correlation, or role change. Resolved: external lineage is non-bearer provenance; exact content-addressed assurance revisions and components change identity, and continuity remains later.
- Unit roles previously risked endpoint-count or within-unit union inflation. Resolved: row 5 freezes static eligibility after collapse, each unit counts once and loses every role on fault; row 6 alone derives one conservative unit observation and attempt-realized role subset without a member winner.
- Admission previously risked a persistent lifecycle or current Head. Resolved: at 65bf it means immutable semantic eligibility on one exact basis only. Contradiction or revocation stales applicability but never mutates the partition; a replacement is separately authorized and inert until bound.

##### Trusted-time acquisition ambiguity resolution

- BFDA's unqualified statement that Run owns acquisition conflicted with the later closed ExecutionAttempt union. Resolved by 1675: Run owns only run-mediated acquisition; Evidence owns durable Observation provenance; Authority owns trusted-time plan and closure; proven-effect-free transport has no Run; effecting and reconciliation Runs retain their existing owners.
- A frozen plan previously risked implying a new durable pre-I/O mutation. Resolved: the complete plan and raw challenge are ephemeral for proven-effect-free transport. Only an effecting leg durably reserves Intent before I/O; any durable Observation or closure publication is a separate authorized mutation.
- Read previously obscured billing, quota, nonce and credential effects. Resolved: the complete Provider Operation Contract classifies the full envelope before I/O; material mutation is effecting and unknown or unbounded behavior is Unavailable.

- Compatible observation previously allowed hidden subset selection and role union. Resolved: every valid contributor enters one relational meet; roles are only those entailed for every point in the complete joint closure.
- Empty overlap previously risked spending F. Resolved: E requires exact attributable authenticated fault Evidence. Ordinary empty meet is PreAlgebraRejected; missing and rejected units enter neither E nor P.

##### Source continuity candidate ambiguity resolution

- One scalar epoch or sequence per atomic Source Unit was unsafe because correlated members may have independently ordered domains. Resolved: each unit owns a finite canonical product of Source Continuity Lanes; a scalar projection exists only when the entire product uniquely entails it.
- Unavailable previously overlapped with semantic relations. Resolved: evaluation is Unavailable or one mutually exclusive Classified CandidateRelation of Same, Advance, Gap, Rollback, Fork or Discontinuous.

Same-generation issuance before serialization changes the basis; no new inventory Head exists.

The final target-template-fulfillment census was at risk of becoming a premature runtime catalog. No standalone selector, Head or Decision is created.

##### Epoch Root Proposal record versus lifecycle ambiguity resolution

Canonical admission was overloaded with applicability/currentness, while abandonment risked becoming mutable status. Resolved: admission is one non-bearer immutable fact; Retracted or Invalidated is one optional terminal negative fact; applicability is derived; physical reachability is generic Persistence. There is no pending/current/selected proposal Head or revival of the same ProposalId.

- Continuity source, continuity obligation and Continuity Class were previously easy to collapse. Resolved by fad9: every mechanically discoverable source becomes one design-time CoverageObligation, but it becomes a class only through IncludedBy; ExplicitlyNonContinuity is an exact proved exclusion and never a third ClassDisposition, runtime waiver or omission-by-silence.
- Owner contribution previously sounded like a runtime registration. Resolved: AuthorityContinuityOwnerContributionV1 is a design-only non-bearer candidate component derived from a complete OwnerCoverageCensus; it creates no Store record, registry entry, Action or authority.
- Proposal negative-disposition name previously risked implying different prospective authority effects. Resolved: Retracted and Invalidated both permanently bar activation of that ProposalId. Their causes differ for audit; additional or later causes belong to protected Evidence. Applicability is a DerivedOnly projection, never stored proposal state.

- Continuity graph cycle previously conflated semantic references with content-hash dependency. Resolved by 3494: the hash DAG is always acyclic; a semantic cycle is representable only under a locked owner edge law with independently identified nodes and nonrecursive canonical set hashing.
- Closure completeness previously risked treating family roots as sufficient. Resolved: exact per-class/per-facet obligations and dispositions are joined by an independent census; flat roots cannot prove omission resistance.
- Closure semantic cut previously risked self-hashing its own Result, Receipt, idempotency mapping or authority consumption. Resolved: all required pre-cut facts enter ClosureId; the closure-establishing transition's post-cut facts remain outside that hash and must be same-commit coupled by 12J.
- Continuity State Token is not a caller nonce, timestamp, revision label or current Head. It is a later 12J-allocated unique successor fence; equal bytes after a distinct transition receive a fresh token.

- No-current Work and no-current Authority Context were previously conflated. Resolved by 618b: RepositoryFirstWorkPublication proves current Work-root absence inside an already established Repository context; actual Repository or Installation genesis is outside the transition-guard kernel.
- Shared transition law previously risked meaning one universal floor/outgoing/incoming formula. Resolved: only mechanics are shared; every TransitionGuardKind has a fixed nominal owner bundle and retains its own comparison, downgrade, continuity, viability and publication law.
- Satisfied guard previously risked bearer or cached-pass meaning. Resolved: TransitionGuardEvaluationV1 is pure ephemeral non-bearer output, stale after any bound change and rederived inside the owning commit.

Trusted-time currentness was previously easy to read as either one active Policy Binding Head or as a property conferred directly by ClosureId plus State Token. Component-local strengthening was previously able to hide whole-stack weakening. Resolved: comparison is over the complete effective Stack and all cross-component constraints. Invalid, Unsupported, Unsatisfiable, Unknown, Contradictory or missing-lineage outcomes refuse; they are not weakening directions that a Mandate can override.

Source-lineage replacement was previously at risk of being inferred from equal Stack or component bytes. Resolved: merge, split, replacement, recovery or floor carry that changes lineage remains unavailable until row 12D supplies an exact bridge.

The term source bridge previously risked duplicating 70c6 comparison. Decision 9a5d resolves ownership: 70c6 alone classifies source relations and supplies ephemeral candidates; 12D consumes eligible candidates and owns total carry admissibility, correlation conservation and obligation generation.

N:M was previously readable as independent pairwise edges. Resolved: Carry Groups are closed components of the full independently derived correlation hypergraph. One indivisible predecessor cannot become several independently countable successors. A legitimate split preserves distinct sub-atoms or one shared correlation identity; otherwise the whole carry refuses.

Monotone H_time conversion was underspecified. Resolved: carry requires identity or a total current-owned core-pinned conversion proving lower-bound soundness, order reflection, no weakening and no fabricated advance. Mere monotonicity is insufficient.

The 4c0b external_registration_ref previously risked being read as proof of remote success. Decision 3a27 resolves it as a locally minted registration-subject identity only; authenticated provider handles and registration success arrive later as Evidence Observations.

Recovery selection token and continuity token were at risk of conflation. Resolved: 4c0b selection state_token changes only through selection transitions; 3494 and 12J ContinuityStateToken changes through continuity publication. Neither substitutes for the other.

Accepted external revision was previously easy to equate with permanently current recovery status. Resolved: acceptance is immutable history; prospective usability additionally requires current selection, Stack, lineage, freshness, anchor and recovery basis. Stale acceptance never ignores a possible later veto.

##### Continuity maintenance authority and capacity ambiguity resolution

A continuity candidate, monotonic floor, provider result, Observation, Receipt, StateToken or recovery status was previously at risk of being treated as enough authority to refresh itself. Decision a659 resolved the source as one closed ContinuityMaintenanceBasis with one exact externally originated purpose slot and executor assertion; the 6170 body, now incorporated by effective 3905, carries that law and adds only the Stack-repair purpose. It is neither an ordinary Grant or Mandate witness nor an authority-free monotonic write. Renaming externally preallocated future uses does not remove their capacity-origin semantics, so the 3905-incorporated 6170/a659 chain also incorporates the 78fb supersession. ##### Effect origin, Action authority and Session ambiguity resolution

EffectOrigin was at risk of being read as the authority for its Intent, and d0be's fresh Session was at risk of becoming mandatory for non-Session CMA reconciliation. The 2a07 correction incorporated by the current composite head resolves both: the exact originating or reconciliation Action leaf statically selects one closed ActionAuthorityBasisV1; EffectOrigin is provenance only. ##### Operational Stack unavailability versus semantic invalidity resolution

An unusable selected Stack previously conflated provider or credential outage with loss of the outgoing policy meaning needed to authorize replacement. The 6170 body, now incorporated by effective 3905, distinguishes them. CMA repair admits only exact TimeUnavailable caused by bounded operational inability while the complete outgoing Stack semantics, comparator and outgoing requirement remain independently valid. - A candidate or unselected Policy Stack cannot validate or authorize its own H_time. The fresh lower candidate must come from the already-authoritative branch policy binding; target-basis carry comes only from ExactNoLineageChange or 9a5d.

Resolved: missing source floor is not zero, repeated ContextGenesis, first response, or implicit absence. IntroducedUninitialized is an explicit noncontributing current-lane cell; SourceLaneOriginCandidate is an ephemeral first-floor candidate after Stack selection, nominally distinct from ContextGenesisOriginCandidate and established-floor CandidateRelation.

Resolved: total source-floor closure does not require fresh I/O on every lane. ExactRetainOnly is an exact no-lineage-change proof over the whole correlated closure and is distinct from observed Same. Gap acceptance is not a generic forward jump: it needs universal T_forall entailment, a closed current-owner purpose law and an immutable companion.

Resolved: an external carrier profile is Authority policy/currentness, not a provider connector or remote attempt. Terminal-prefix handoff is pre-cut logical continuity; remote occurrence is separate 12I-O evidence and local selection is separate 12J publication. Latest, dual current and local-memory terminality are invalid.

Resolved: occurrence is per exact Intent/Attempt, not semantic currentness. Timeout, not-found, provider success, head equality and different successor are not definitive negative proof. ConfirmedExternalPrefixAwaitingLocalPublication is a protected derived Condition, not a Head or lifecycle. The remote record carries pre-cut target Action and selected Mandate/Grant consumption commitments but no future local Result/currentness/self digest.

Resolved: ClosureId covers the coherent pre-cut census plus fresh Store-owned token; transition-created selections, floors, consumption, mutation/Intent, Receipt, Result, idempotency, fence and currentness remain outside their own ClosureId but become visible in the same commit and enter the next closure. Same numeric values do not imply an all-identical no-op across basis changes.

"Preparation" now means only an exact proposal-admission semantic mutation and its non-bearer eligibility proof, never a prepared successor lifecycle, pending Head, proposal selection, Epoch/G0 reservation or activation. The fresh c234 StateToken is current continuity identity, not proposal currentness. Transport reservation is Execution-owned 5f23 state and grants no Authority-domain preparation or future-Epoch claim.

"Disposition" means a complete typed future activation consequence for each old continuity member, not an umbrella Epoch status, deletion, successor mapping or current mutation. TransitionConsumed and EpochRetired are inert plan terms until 13B commits. HistoricalOnly preserves constraints without authority. UnresolvedEffectPreserved is Execution-owned survival, not carry or retry.

##### Final batch ambiguity closure

The earlier open terms are resolved as follows:

- “Run owner” means exactly one closed ExecutionAttempt variant, never provenance plus Lease dual ownership.
- “Activation” distinguishes inactive closure construction, protected carrier publication, confirmed occurrence and later client admission; none is inferred from path/head observation.
- “Rollback” means verified inverse Distribution work before ambiguity or fresh-generation recovery; it never means Store rewind, authority refund or old-generation failback.
- “Capability” means support/availability evidence, never authorization or Projection eligibility. “Maturity” is multidimensional presentation, never permission.
- “Search” is retrieval Projection. “Memory” is governed advisory learning. “Intake” is untrusted-source custody. “Research” is revisioned inquiry. None is a hidden state or next engine.
- “Committed” is local semantic publication only. “Replay” is response metadata. “In doubt” requires a possibly crossed declared effect boundary.
- “Continuity class” is generated from independent owner obligations; audit-family labels are not classes and descriptors are not executable.
- “Capacity maximum” is a finite human-governed incoming value bound before context activation, not universal hard-coded quota or mutable runtime configuration.
- “Public model” is Work/Step. v1 Card/Task/Feature/Progress spellings are migration-only and never aliases.

There is no remaining known material ambiguity after these locks. Any final-advisor or edge-sweep finding that introduces an alternative owner, authority, lifecycle, migration-safety rule or irreversible public contract must reopen a separate Decision; wording, proof and census omissions may be repaired without a new fork.

##### Recovery admission, recovery execution, and result-resolution ambiguity resolved

Recovery admission and Store Generation recovery are distinct Ceremonies with distinct Attempt identities, carriers, uncertainty, and stop points. Admission produces only an inert admission record; later recovery execution requires that exact confirmed record and cannot manufacture it. Pre-store result closure is `ResolveResult`, a closed no-Run mode of the same admission CeremonySpec, not a new Ceremony, `ReconciliationAttempt`, retry, result-read side effect, or hidden journal. `operation result` is pure and may only point to a typed `ResolveResult` submission route.

##### Governed-review carrier classification and leaf-reuse ambiguity resolved

A carrier operation is exactly `ProvenEffectFree`, `Effecting`, or `Unavailable` before I/O under a core-derived pinned provider contract. Presentation and response do not require bespoke Action leaves: their exact Effect Origin and Observation Kind subjects keep generic Execution and Evidence leaves semantically closed. Provider, adapter, renderer, Recipe, callback and later intent cannot classify, retry, buffer or donate authority.

##### Distribution remote acquisition versus local apply ambiguity resolved

Remote provider acquisition is an Execution-owned effect over the Distribution-owned immutable Plan and artifact subject. `ReserveDistributionEffect` and `PublishDistributionOccurrence` belong only to later local filesystem, manager or binary phases and cannot dispatch or classify provider truth. Provider operation class is exactly `ProvenEffectFree | Effecting | Unavailable`; no adapter, cache, receipt or dry-run label widens it.

##### Capability view versus persistent probe ambiguity resolved

Capability and Maturity reads never execute a provider procedure or persist freshness. Persistent probing is an explicit active-store Action path classified as `ProvenEffectFree | Effecting | Unavailable`. `CapabilityProbe` cannot swallow ProcessLiveness, SecurityAnalysis, InstalledBinary or RemoteReadback, and probe success cannot become authorization, eligibility, continuation or maturity authority.

##### CMA purpose versus Observation kind ambiguity resolved

A CMA Observation-publication slot is not a generic permission to publish any Evidence. Purpose, exact Observation kind and exact source-route role are all immutable slot-subject members. Registration-derived and status-derived anchor revisions are distinct routes, carrier integrity fault is carrier-purpose-only, and generic readback or diagnostic kinds cannot substitute.

##### Action authority-basis and owner ambiguity resolved

Ordinary, leaf-local Bootstrap G0 and CMA authorization are disjoint exact leaf contracts, not caller-selectable alternatives. `PublishBootstrapMandateInteractionOutcome` is the sole final census leaf; e138's longer candidate spelling is not an alias. Effect Origin is mandatory provenance for effect phases but never authority. CMA slot classes have finite natural-subject sets; only the ten Observation edges use contiguous ordinal ranges.

##### Effect originator and Distribution phase ambiguity resolved

Effect Origin has one `origin_source_owner` but a finite nonempty route set, not one operation owner. Active-Store Distribution effects use the ordinary Execution Intent/outcome/reconciliation leaves plus typed same-Attempt `RecoverReserved` on the same reserve leaf; `ReserveDistributionEffect`, `PublishDistributionOccurrence`, and `RecoverDistributionTransaction` own only Distribution workflow phases. ## 14. Dependency-ordered implementation stages

Staging is delivery order only and cannot reduce product scope. The canonical prerequisite order governs integration, certification and currentness claims; the parallel candidate-execution overlay below may advance isolated implementation work without advancing any Stage gate.

The user-facing Final Build Approval Packet is an external workspace-control artifact only. Its required field is named `External Build Plan Handoff hash` and is the hash of a domain-separated external `ExternalBuildPlanHandoffV1` that binds the exact pinned design, card, Decision closure, census, implementation baseline and staged implementation/proof plan. It is not the canonical vNext Build Handoff, is not stored or interpreted by Maestro, and cannot be converted to or compared as a Design Finalization Manifest, candidate Contract Root, canonical Build Handoff Projection, Agent Packet, Action Request, Receipt, Grant or Mandate. Before Stage 0, the canonical Build Handoff does not exist.

`ExternalCandidateInputCommitmentV1` is the external provisional commitment to those exact pinned inputs. It is not a candidate Contract Root or Contract identity. The exact approval token is a fresh authenticated user instruction to the external implementation agent and session to start only the bound repository implementation and proof plan. It creates no Maestro fact or authority. Acceptance requires one platform-attested current user-role event in the exact recipient task, with an immutable event identity and task incarnation demonstrably later than publication of the bound packet. Message text alone, Packet text, advisor text, an agent echo, a prior message or a copied token cannot self-authorize. If the external platform cannot attest the role, event identity, recipient-task incarnation or post-packet ordering, the executor refuses before every write. No Maestro parser, migration path, Projection, Action handler or Authority evaluator accepts or stores this external event.

##### Reproducible external approval-packet commitment

Every digest below is lowercase 64-character hexadecimal SHA-256. Canonical text is UTF-8, LF-only, no BOM, no trailing spaces and exactly one final LF. Define `LP(name, value)` as UTF-8 `name`, ASCII `=`, the base-10 UTF-8 byte length of `value` without leading zeroes, ASCII `:`, the exact UTF-8 `value`, then LF. A scalar value contains no CR, LF or NUL. A structured human section is hashed from its complete canonical text before its digest is used as a scalar. Concatenation is byte concatenation; the domain separator ends in one NUL byte.

`ExternalCandidateInputCommitmentV1` is SHA-256 of domain separator `maestro.external-candidate-input.v1\0` followed by these `LP` records in exact order: `source_repository_realpath`, `implementation_workspace_path`, `implementation_workspace_policy`, `baseline_commit`, `baseline_tree`, `source_git_control_binding_sha256`, `destination_ancestor_binding_sha256`, `checkout_sandbox_profile_sha256`, `feature_id`, `feature_state`, `card_sha256`, `design_sha256`, `decisions_sha256`, `raw_decision_inventory_sha256`, `external_design_authority_closure_sha256`, `capability_census_sha256`, `resource_consumer_census_sha256`, `migration_rollback_removal_sha256`. `implementation_workspace_policy` is exactly `dedicated-clean-worktree-v1`. Before token acceptance or any write, the executor binds the source Git common-directory identity and object source, the complete existing destination-ancestor chain through the exact parent, and the exact packet-bound Git-control, destination-ancestor and checkout-sandbox manifests defined below. Every bound directory is reached through a no-follow descriptor chain and must have the expected realpath, physical identity, owner and safe mode; a symlink, alias ambiguity, ancestor replacement, nested repository, Gitlink mismatch, unsafe owner/mode or changing bound input refuses. The exact `implementation_workspace_path` and its immediate parent must respectively be absent and present; the bound source must still expose the exact `baseline_commit` and `baseline_tree`. Token acceptance authorizes only one atomic exclusive no-follow creation at that bound leaf. The only later source-common-directory mutation is one exact expected-absent linked-worktree administrative registration for that leaf and baseline; config, refs, objects and every unrelated worktree entry are read-only, and partial registration enters fresh-authority recovery. Registration is no-checkout. Tree materialization and clean verification use the packet-bound raw-object no-exec sandbox, not ordinary checkout/status behavior. Every system/global/repository/worktree hook, clean/smudge/process filter, fsmonitor, pager, editor, credential/helper, signing helper, external submodule command, configuration include, object helper, remote/network fetch and other external command path is unavailable; no bound or unbound executable configuration may run. If the platform cannot provide those primitives, Stage 0 refuses. The successful exclusive leaf creation is the one-use consumption fence: duplicate or racing deliveries lose with zero write; a crash before creation may retry the same attested event, while a crash at or after creation requires the separately defined recovery path and a fresh authorization rather than token replay. After registration and raw materialization, but before any source or generated-file edit, the executor revalidates the complete bindings plus matching HEAD, exact tree modes and blob identities, empty index diff, empty tracked-worktree diff, zero untracked entries, exact Gitlink entries with no submodule checkout, no nested-repository substitution and safe realpath/ownership through the same no-exec verifier. The current source checkout may remain dirty because it is never the implementation workspace.

`ExternalGitSourceControlBindingV1` is SHA-256 of domain separator `maestro.external-git-source-control.v1\0` followed by `LP` records in exact order: `source_repository_realpath`, `git_common_dir_realpath`, `git_common_dir_device`, `git_common_dir_inode`, `git_common_dir_uid`, `git_common_dir_gid`, `git_common_dir_mode`, `object_directory_realpath`, `object_directory_device`, `object_directory_inode`, `object_directory_uid`, `object_directory_gid`, `object_directory_mode`, `object_format`, `repository_config_sha256`, `git_control_path_manifest_sha256`, `baseline_commit`, `baseline_tree`. Decimal metadata has no leading zero; mode is four lowercase octal digits. `GitControlPathManifestV1` is canonical UTF-8/LF text with one final LF and one sorted `relative_path<TAB>state<TAB>sha256_or_dash` row for the exact closed set `config.worktree`, `objects/info/alternates`, `info/attributes`, `info/grafts`, `shallow`, every `refs/replace/**` file and every `objects/pack/*.promisor` file under the bound Git directories. State is exactly `absent | regular`; non-regular, alternate, graft, replace, shallow or promisor material refuses this profile rather than becoming an executable or remote object source. Repository config is content-bound for substitution detection but is not consumed by registration, materialization or verification. The sandbox uses only the bound read-only local object directory and proves the baseline commit, tree and every required object are present without lazy fetch.

`ExternalDestinationAncestorBindingV1` is SHA-256 of domain separator `maestro.external-destination-ancestors.v1\0` followed by `LP(ancestor_count, N)` and then, for every existing ancestor from filesystem root through the exact immediate parent in root-to-leaf order, indexed `LP` records `ancestor_<i>_path`, `ancestor_<i>_realpath`, `ancestor_<i>_device`, `ancestor_<i>_inode`, `ancestor_<i>_uid`, `ancestor_<i>_gid`, `ancestor_<i>_mode`, `ancestor_<i>_type`. Type is exactly `directory`; mode is four lowercase octal digits. The immediate parent must already exist. No intermediate directory creation, symlink, alias substitution, writable-by-other ancestor or changed metadata is permitted by the packet.

`ExternalCheckoutSandboxProfileV1` is SHA-256 of domain separator `maestro.external-checkout-sandbox.v1\0` followed by exact `LP` records: `profile_id=raw-tree-no-exec-v1`, `config_sources=none`, `hooks=disabled`, `filters=disabled`, `attributes_transform=disabled`, `external_commands=disabled`, `network=disabled`, `submodule_checkout=disabled`, `object_source=packet-bound-read-only`, `registration=expected-absent-no-checkout`, `materializer=raw-tree-object-decoder`, `verifier=raw-tree-object-decoder`, `symlink_policy=tree-exact-no-escape-before-edit`, in that order. The executor must isolate or sandbox the operation so an attempted executable config, filter, hook, helper or network access is a hard failure with no external effect; merely hashing or allowlisting a command is insufficient.

The raw Decision inventory is a canonical LF-terminated sequence sorted by Decision id; each line is `id<TAB>status<TAB>raw_supersedes_csv<TAB>raw_superseded_by`, with empty columns where absent. `ExternalDesignAuthorityClosureV1` is a separate external authoring-only manifest, never a vNext Decision Closure Manifest. It contains one `N` line per id, sorted by id, as `N<TAB>id<TAB>node_disposition<TAB>effective_head_id`; its closed node dispositions are exactly `locked_head | superseded_matched | superseded_matched_with_ignored_claim | invalid_status | invalid_successor | invalid_cycle`. It then contains one `E` line per distinct raw directional claim, sorted by `(predecessor_id, successor_id, source_direction)`, as `E<TAB>predecessor_id<TAB>successor_id<TAB>source_direction<TAB>edge_disposition`; source direction is exactly `superseded_by | supersedes`, and edge disposition is exactly `matched_single | matched_composite | ignored_unilateral_claim | invalid_missing_target | invalid_multiple_successors | invalid_cycle`.

The algorithm is total. Each record contributes its raw `superseded_by` claim and every raw `supersedes` claim. A usable successor edge requires exactly one predecessor `superseded_by` target, an existing target whose raw `supersedes` set includes that predecessor, and an acyclic graph. Several predecessors may point to the same successor only as `matched_composite`, an external v1 authoring-incorporation fact that is forbidden from becoming a canonical vNext Decision Supersession. Following usable successor edges yields one terminal effective head. Any unmatched reverse claim is `ignored_unilateral_claim` and contributes no edge or head change; missing targets, several successor claims for one predecessor, or cycles invalidate that node closure. The three known ignored claims are `dec-public-wire-contract-2f11 -> dec-canonical-agent-control-plane-contract-25a5`, `dec-branch-publication-carriers-2f11 -> dec-canonical-carrier-specific-ed08` and `dec-canonical-non-action-protected-90a9 -> dec-canonical-trusted-host-protected-1fbc`. The first two predecessor pointers instead participate in matched composite authoring heads `dec-canonical-vnext-wire-envelope-and-a510` and `dec-canonical-branch-recovery-publication-e287`; the third predecessor remains a compatible locked head and the trusted-host card remains a stricter additive locked head. Both manifest digests are committed, so external normalization cannot hide, repair, migrate or promote source bytes.

`ExternalBuildPlanHandoffV1` is SHA-256 of domain separator `maestro.external-build-plan-handoff.v1\0` followed by these `LP` records in exact order: `external_candidate_input_commitment`, `recipient_task_id`, `stage_plan_sha256`, `proof_gate_sha256`, `risk_recovery_sha256`, `adapter_removal_sha256`. The recipient is the exact Codex task that must receive the later approval command; a different task, baseline, implementation-workspace path or policy, plan, proof or risk boundary produces a different hash.

The human review packet has these exact ordered canonical sections: `identity_state`, `product_constitution`, `architecture_ownership`, `capability_resource_census`, `lifecycle_authority`, `migration_rollback_removal`, `implementation_stages_proofs`, `risk_recovery`, `advisor_dispositions_edge_sweep`, `deviations_recommendation`. Each displayed section states its own SHA-256 over its exact section text. `ExternalBuildApprovalPacketV1` is SHA-256 of domain separator `maestro.external-build-approval-packet.v1\0` followed by these `LP` records in exact order: `feature_id`, `feature_state`, `source_repository_realpath`, `implementation_workspace_path`, `implementation_workspace_policy`, `baseline_commit`, `baseline_tree`, `source_git_control_binding_sha256`, `destination_ancestor_binding_sha256`, `checkout_sandbox_profile_sha256`, `card_sha256`, `design_sha256`, `decisions_sha256`, `raw_decision_inventory_sha256`, `external_design_authority_closure_sha256`, `external_candidate_input_commitment`, `external_build_plan_handoff`, `candidate_contract_root`, `canonical_build_handoff`, then one `<section_name>_sha256` record for each human section in the order above. Before Stage 0, the two canonical fields have the literal values `absent-before-stage-0`; they are never populated with an external substitute.

The packet hash and approval token are deliberately outside the hashed record set. After hashing the complete ordered record set, display `External packet SHA-256: <digest>` and define the exact token as `sha256:<digest>`. Neither display line, the Markdown wrapper, explanatory text outside the ten section bodies, nor the approval command is included in the packet hash. Verification recomputes every section digest, both external commitments and the packet digest from the pinned files and exact records; any mismatch, changed byte, missing field, reordering, duplicate field, changed recipient, non-absent implementation path, changed baseline commit/tree, missing platform attestation, wrong user role or task incarnation, non-fresh event, or event not causally later than the packet invalidates the token before acceptance. After acceptance, the bound plan authorizes only the exact atomic exclusive creation protocol above; a duplicate delivery, creation race, ancestor/common-directory/configuration/filter substitution, dirty index, tracked or untracked byte, wrong mode, symlink or realpath substitution, Gitlink/submodule mismatch, different HEAD/tree or source-checkout execution stops Stage 0 before every source edit. The only accepted continuation phrase is the fresh user instruction `APPROVE BUILD PACKET sha256:<digest>. Execute the staged build plan.`

Stage 0 is the first externally user-authorized, non-runtime literal-materialization gate. Token acceptance follows the read-only source-common-directory, destination-ancestor, checkout-control, absent-leaf, baseline and platform-event verification. The first authorized write is the atomic exclusive no-follow creation of the exact dedicated worktree and simultaneously consumes that approval event; immediate post-creation revalidation must pass before any source or generated-file mutation. A failed or partial creation remains non-authoritative and enters the external recovery boundary under fresh authorization; it is never completed by replaying the consumed token. Stage 0 then deterministically generates the literal schemas and candidate Contract Components, then the exact candidate Contract Root, then the matching immutable Design Finalization Manifest, then the canonical Build Handoff Projection. Any byte mismatch, new material choice, changed Design or external design-authority closure, changed raw Decision inventory, changed acceptance, external plan or bound input, or inability to reproduce the bound inputs invalidates the external packet and returns to Design without continuing. Stage 0 publishes no active Contract and creates no executable runtime behavior.

The external-control falsifier is exact. It covers a same-task prior token, copied token, wrong-role event, wrong task incarnation, event ordered before packet publication, duplicate delivery before and after creation, two concurrent acceptors, crash before exclusive creation, crash after leaf creation, crash before/during/after the exact no-checkout administrative registration, registration-name collision, ancestor rename or symlink swap, destination-parent replacement, source common-directory or object-source substitution, every system/global/repository/worktree hook, every bound or unbound clean/smudge/process filter, every command-valued configuration/helper, attribute transform, configuration include, fsmonitor, pager/editor/signing/submodule command, object helper and attempted network access, control-path/config mutation, nested-repository and Gitlink substitution, ordinary checkout/status accidentally entering the path, and post-materialization HEAD/tree-mode/blob/index/tracked/untracked mismatch. Before exclusive creation, every rejected or losing case performs zero write. After successful leaf creation, only that leaf and the exact expected-absent administrative registration may exist; no source code, config, ref, object or unrelated worktree metadata may change, the original event is consumed, and any partial state requires fresh-authority recovery. Lack of a platform-authenticated event identity/task incarnation, descriptor-anchored exclusive no-follow creation, packet-bound manifest equality, no-exec registration/materialization/verification or a sandbox capable of blocking attempted external effects is itself a conclusive refusal, never a convenience fallback.

Canonical Contract publication remains a later and separate authority transition. It requires the exact Stage-0 candidate Contract Root, the matching immutable Design Finalization Manifest and a freshly authorized nondelegable one-use human Mandate consumed only inside the matching publication transaction under the Repository Governance Floor, current outgoing requirement when present and candidate incoming requirement. Neither the external packet nor its token substitutes for that Mandate or grants effect, migration, cutover, removal, release or completion authority. External packet material is outside Maestro migration; if encountered it is retained only as opaque non-promoting provenance or sealed quarantine.

The Stage-0 literal gate freezes `SubmissionClaimSetV1` with exactly `submission_id`, positive `claim_count` and ordered entries of `claim_id`, `normalized_proposition_hash` and `claim_record_hash`; the literal `maestro.submission-claim-set.v1` domain; unsigned-64-bit big-endian count and length-prefixed variable fields; canonical ordering; every rejection product; and every dependency-bound schema, Manifest, Resource, Bundle, Census, Release, candidate-root and Handoff identity under two independent encoders and semantic validation. The Stage-3 Work/Contract/Design/Decision gate must prove one and many Claims, the shared finite Action Request typed-input limit and absence of every second Claim-count cap, ambient default or adapter override across CLI, JSON, MCP, TUI, hook, shell and Skill paths. Failure leaves the prior root/currentness unchanged and returns to Design.
